_about_en: Teaching packs are written by My Culture Connect to go with Dom Jones's lesson plans. Dom chooses the week's power vocabulary; the Chinese, the examples and the practice sets here are ours, so that a teacher can run her plan with no preparation. Kept in a separate file from data/lesson-plans.json so that re-importing Dom's PDF never overwrites our additions, and so it stays obvious which words are whose.
_about_zh: 教學包由人師教育協會編寫，搭配 Dom Jones 的教案使用。每週的核心字彙是 Dom 選的；這裡的中文、例句與練習是我們加的，目的是讓老師不必備課就能把她的教案上完。刻意與 lesson-plans.json 分檔，重新匯入 Dom 的 PDF 不會蓋掉我們加的東西，也一眼看得出哪部分是誰寫的。

1.prep_en: No preparation needed. Read the lightning round off the screen. Students need one sheet of paper for their Word Bank.
1.prep_zh: 不必備課。中翻英練習直接照螢幕唸。學生只需要一張紙做自己的單字銀行。

words.example: Let me introduce myself — my name is Yi-Chen and I play basketball.
words.more: introduce → introduction (n.)

words.example: Tell me about one experience you had this summer.
words.more: experience → experienced (adj.)

words.example: Speaking English for sixty seconds is my challenge today.
words.more: ≈ difficult task · challenge → challenging (adj.)

words.example: This year I want to improve my listening.
words.more: ≈ get better · ↔ get worse

words.example: She felt confident when she answered in English.
words.more: ↔ nervous, shy · confident → confidence (n.)

words.example: Good learners stay curious — they always ask why.
words.more: ↔ bored · curious → curiosity (n.)

words.example: What is your favorite food in your hometown?
words.more: British spelling: favourite

words.example: Today you will discover how many English words you already know.
words.more: ≈ find out · discover → discovery (n.)

practice.title_zh: 中翻英快問快答
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min speed round. Read the Chinese, students race to say the English. All eight words appear.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的 Speed Round。唸中文，學生搶答英文。八個字全部出現。
items: 我想介紹我的家人。 → I want to introduce my family.
那是一次很棒的體驗。 → That was a great experience.
這對我來說是一個挑戰。 → This is a challenge for me.
我想改善我的發音。 → I want to improve my pronunciation.
她說英文的時候很有自信。 → She is confident when she speaks English.
我對你的暑假很好奇。 → I am curious about your summer.
你最喜歡的科目是什麼？ → What is your favorite subject?
我今天發現了一個新單字。 → I discovered a new word today.

practice.title_zh: 六十秒自我介紹・句型架構
practice.note_en: Put these on the board. A1 students fill in two frames; B1 and above should link them into one flowing minute.
practice.note_zh: 寫在白板上。A1 學生填兩句就好；B1 以上要把句子串成流暢的一分鐘。
items: My name is ______ and my favorite ______ is ______.
One experience I will never forget is ______.
This year I want to improve my ______.
I feel confident when I ______.
I am curious about ______.

practice.title_zh: 同義反義對決
practice.note_en: Two teams. Say the word, the other team must answer with a synonym or an opposite.
practice.note_zh: 分兩隊。唸出單字，另一隊要接出同義詞或反義詞。
items: confident ↔ nervous / shy
curious ↔ bored
improve ↔ get worse
discover ≈ find out
challenge ≈ difficult task
favorite ≈ the one I like best

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一人一句
practice.note_en: Dom's plan asks every student to produce something before leaving. This is the smallest version that still counts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的教案要求每個學生離開前都要產出東西。這是最小、但仍然算數的版本。
items: Today I discovered that I already know about ______ English words.
This year I want to improve my ______.

2.prep_en: No preparation needed. Write 'I like dogs.' on the board and build from there. Note that this week's eight words are the lesson itself: three adjectives, three adverbs, two conjunctions — the exact materials a sentence grows with.
2.prep_zh: 不必備課。在白板寫下「I like dogs.」就能開始。請注意：本週八個字本身就是這堂課——三個形容詞、三個副詞、兩個連接詞，正好是把句子養大的三種材料。

words.example: The library was quiet, so we could hear the rain outside.
words.more: ↔ noisy, loud · quiet (adj.) → quietly (adv.)

words.example: My grandmother brought out an enormous mooncake after dinner.
words.more: ≈ huge, gigantic · ↔ tiny

words.example: He quickly wrote the new word in his notebook.
words.more: ↔ slowly · quick (adj.) → quickly (adv.)

words.example: She carefully carried the hot soup to the table.
words.more: ↔ carelessly · careful (adj.) → carefully (adv.)

words.example: The last ten minutes of the game were exciting.
words.more: ↔ boring · 小心：exciting 是「令人興奮的」，excited 是「（人）感到興奮的」

words.example: Surprisingly, my little brother finished the race first.
words.more: surprise (n./v.) → surprising (adj.) → surprisingly (adv.)

words.example: Although it rained, we still went outside to look at the moon.
words.more: ≈ though, even though · 小心：英文只用一個連接詞，不說 Although…, but…

words.example: We had a barbecue because it was Mid-Autumn Festival.
words.more: because 接原因，so 接結果 · 小心：不能同一句用「Because…, so…」

practice.title_en: The Sentence Builder · a worked ladder
practice.title_zh: 句子養成梯・示範
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Show this ladder first so students see where they are going, then start a new one as a class. Every rung adds one kind of information.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。先示範這道梯子，讓學生看見終點在哪，再全班一起爬一道新的。每一階只加一種訊息。
items: I like dogs.
+ adjective → I like enormous dogs.
+ adverb → I quietly play with enormous dogs.
+ because → I quietly play with enormous dogs because they are friendly.
+ although → Although my mother says no, I quietly play with the enormous dog next door because he is surprisingly friendly. (19 words)
Now start a new ladder: “We eat mooncakes.” / “The class is noisy.” / “She runs.”

practice.title_zh: 句子升級・五個字變十二個字
practice.note_en: This is exactly the homework Dom sets, so run one in class first. Model answer given for the first item.
practice.note_zh: 這正是 Dom 出的回家作業，所以課堂上先帶一題。第一題附示範答案。
items: The boy ran. → Although he was tired, the boy ran quickly to the bus stop because the rain was getting heavy. (20 words)
We watched the moon. → ______
My father cooks. → ______
The test was hard. → ______
They played a game. → ______

practice.title_zh: 兩個中文帶來的陷阱
practice.note_en: Both of this week's conjunctions have a matching pair in Chinese that English does not use. Expect these errors — they are not carelessness, they are the first language showing through. Fix them together.
practice.note_zh: 本週兩個連接詞在中文裡都是成對出現，英文卻只用一個。學生一定會犯——那不是粗心，是母語在說話。一起把它們改過來。
items: 雖然下雨，但是我們還是出門了。 ✗ Although it rained, but we still went out. ✓ Although it rained, we still went out.
因為月亮很亮，所以我們在外面吃。 ✗ Because the moon was bright, so we ate outside. ✓ Because the moon was bright, we ate outside.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Although the mooncake was enormous, but I finished it.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Because I practiced carefully, so I improved quickly.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個長句
practice.note_en: One sentence about Mid-Autumn Festival, at least twelve words, using because or although and one word from this week.
practice.note_zh: 寫一句中秋節的句子，至少十二個字，要用到 because 或 although，加上本週任一個單字。
items: Example: Although the night was quiet, our family laughed a lot because we barbecued together.
Your sentence: ______

3.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom sets three families rather than single words — the point is the shape of the word, not the word. The ending tells you the job: -ness / -tion / -ty make nouns, -ful / -ive make adjectives, -ly makes adverbs, un- flips the meaning.
3.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 這週給的是三個詞族而不是三個單字——重點是字的形狀，不是字本身。字尾就是職稱：-ness／-tion／-ty 變名詞，-ful／-ive 變形容詞，-ly 變副詞，un- 把意思翻面。

words.example: The beauty of Lukang is in its old streets.
words.more: 家族 ①　-ty → 名詞

words.example: We took a photo in front of the beautiful temple.
words.more: -ful → 形容詞

words.example: She sings beautifully.
words.more: -ly → 副詞（修飾動作，不是人）

words.example: The whole class was happy when the bell rang.
words.more: 家族 ②

words.example: Happiness is a warm bowl of beef noodles.
words.more: -ness → 名詞

words.example: They happily walked home together.
words.more: -ly → 副詞

words.example: He looked unhappy about the test result.
words.more: un- → 相反（un- 加在形容詞前面）

words.example: Each team will create a poster about their hometown.
words.more: 家族 ③　原形是動詞

words.example: That is a creative way to solve the problem.
words.more: -ive → 形容詞

words.example: The students showed their creations to the whole school.
words.more: -tion → 名詞

practice.title_en: Word Family Factory · one root, fully built
practice.title_zh: 詞族工廠・示範一個字根
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Build this one on the board first, then hand each team a root. Ask for a sentence with every form — a form they cannot use in a sentence does not count.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。先在白板上把這個字根長完，再發給每組一個字根。每種形式都要造句——造不出句子的形式不算數。
items: care (v./n.) → I care about my grandmother.
careful (adj.) → Be careful on the stairs.
carefully (adv.) → He carefully opened the box.
careless (adj.) → A careless mistake cost us the game.　(-less = 沒有)
carelessness (n.) → Her carelessness broke the cup.
Team roots: teach · help · use · friend · hope · safe

practice.title_en: Suffix detective · the ending tells you the job
practice.title_zh: 字尾偵探・字尾就是職稱
practice.note_en: Say each word, students call out noun, adjective or adverb — from the ending alone, without knowing the meaning. That is the whole skill of this week.
practice.note_zh: 唸出每個字，學生只看字尾就喊出名詞、形容詞或副詞——不必知道意思。這就是本週要練的唯一技能。
items: kindness → ？　　darkness → ？　　(-ness = 名詞)
colorful → ？　　powerful → ？　　(-ful = 形容詞)
slowly → ？　　suddenly → ？　　(-ly = 副詞)
invention → ？　　decision → ？　　(-tion / -sion = 名詞)
unfair → ？　　unlucky → ？　　(un- = 相反)
Harder — one root, all three: active · activity · actively

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese words do not change shape
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文的字不會變形
practice.note_en: In Chinese, 美 stays 美 whether it is a noun, an adjective or an adverb — the sentence decides. English changes the word itself. This is why students say 'She sings beautiful'. It is not carelessness; the first language simply has no such rule.
practice.note_zh: 中文裡「美」不管當名詞、形容詞還是副詞都是「美」，靠句子決定。英文卻要把字本身改掉。這就是為什麼學生會說 She sings beautiful——不是粗心，母語裡根本沒有這條規則。
items: 她唱得很美。 ✗ She sings beautiful. ✓ She sings beautifully.
他很有創意。 ✗ He is creation. ✓ He is creative.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ The children played happy in the park.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I felt happiness when I saw my grades.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · and a sign hunt
practice.title_zh: 出場券・順便獵一張告示
practice.note_en: The exit ticket first. The sign hunt is Dom's culture connection — English word families are all over Taiwanese campuses and menus once you start looking.
practice.note_zh: 先寫出場券。獵告示是 Dom 指定的文化連結——開始留意之後，會發現台灣校園和菜單上到處都是英文詞族。
items: Exit ticket: pick one root, write three forms, use one in a sentence.
Sign hunt: photograph one English sign this week and bring the word family.
Starters you will actually find: Recycle / Recycling / Recyclable
Safety / Safe / Safely　·　Entrance / Enter　·　Delicious (menus)

4.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom's four sets are ladders, not lists: each one climbs from an ordinary word to a strong one. Teach the rungs, not the words.
4.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 這週給的四組是階梯，不是清單：每一組都從一個普通的字爬到一個有力的字。教的是階，不是字。

words.example: The soup was good.
words.more: 階梯 ①　★☆☆ 普通

words.example: Her pronunciation is excellent.
words.more: ★★☆ 明顯比好更好

words.example: He gave an outstanding performance at the school concert.
words.more: ★★★ 少數人才配得上

words.example: The weather was bad on Sunday.
words.more: 階梯 ②　★☆☆

words.example: Forgetting the tickets was disastrous.
words.more: ★★★ disaster (n.) → disastrous (adj.)

words.example: I am happy to see you.
words.more: 階梯 ③　★☆☆

words.example: We were delighted when she won.
words.more: ★★☆ 比 happy 正式一點

words.example: The team was ecstatic after the last-second goal.
words.more: ★★★ 誇張的程度，別亂用

words.example: That is a big box.
words.more: 階梯 ④　★☆☆

words.example: An enormous banyan tree stands in front of the temple.
words.more: ★★☆ 上週學過，這週再用一次

words.example: The typhoon caused colossal damage to the harbor.
words.more: ★★★ 用在真正巨大的事物

practice.title_zh: 單字升級拍賣會・拍賣品
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Six weak sentences go under the hammer. Teams bid imaginary money; the best upgrade wins the lot. Pay more for precise, less for merely longer.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。六個軟弱的句子上台拍賣，各組用假錢競標，升級得最好的隊伍得標。精準才值錢，只是變長不值錢。
items: Lot 1　The night market food was good.
Lot 2　Our school trip was bad.
Lot 3　She was happy about her test.
Lot 4　The temple is big.
Lot 5　The movie was very very good.
Lot 6　I had a bad day and a bad dinner.

practice.title_zh: 別爬過頭
practice.note_en: Chinese turns up the volume with 很 / 非常 / 超 on the same word, so students reach for 'very very good'. English changes the word instead — but the top rung is for big occasions. 'I was ecstatic about my sandwich' is funny, not strong. Pick the rung that fits the event.
practice.note_zh: 中文用「很／非常／超」在同一個字上加大音量，所以學生會說 very very good。英文是換字——但最高一階要留給大場面。I was ecstatic about my sandwich 只會很好笑。挑對階，不是挑最高階。
items: Your friend passed a small quiz. → happy or ecstatic?
Taiwan won an Olympic gold medal. → happy or ecstatic?
Your lunch box was nice today. → good or outstanding?
A classmate saved someone's life. → good or outstanding?
It rained during your picnic. → bad or disastrous?

practice.title_zh: 萬聖節單字銀行
practice.note_en: Dom's October connection. Same upgrade move, spooky but gentle — good for a warm-up or for the auction lots if the class wants a theme.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的十月連結。一樣是升級的動作，但換成萬聖節主題，嚇人而不嚇壞——可以當暖身，或直接拿來當拍賣品。
items: scary → spooky (★★☆) → terrifying (★★★)
dark → gloomy (★★☆) → pitch-black (★★★)
old → ancient (★★★)
strange → mysterious (★★☆) → eerie (★★★)
Example: The old house was dark and scary. → The ancient house was gloomy and terrifying.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・升級並說明理由
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks students to explain two of their choices, so practise the explaining here. 'It sounds better' is not an explanation; 'it is stronger and the event was big' is.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要學生說明其中兩個選擇的理由，所以在這裡先練說明。「聽起來比較好」不算理由；「這個字更強，而且那件事夠大」才算。
items: Upgrade one word in this sentence: My weekend was good.
Then finish: I chose ______ instead of ______ because ______.

5.prep_en: No preparation needed. The eight words split into two teams: usually / often / every day point at the present simple, right now / currently / today point at the present continuous. Teach the signal words and the tense follows.
5.prep_zh: 不必備課。八個字分成兩隊：usually／often／every day 指向現在簡單式，right now／currently／today 指向現在進行式。先教訊號字，時態自己就跟上來了。

words.example: I usually take the bus to school.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在簡單式（習慣）

words.example: We often eat dumplings on Sunday.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在簡單式

words.example: She practices the piano every day.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在簡單式 · 放句尾

words.example: Right now I am writing in my notebook.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在進行式

words.example: We are currently studying the water cycle.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在進行式 · 比 right now 正式

words.example: Today we are working in pairs.
words.more: 兩種都可以，看你說的是今天的習慣還是此刻的動作

words.example: The team practices after school every day.
words.more: 第三人稱單數要加 -s：he practices

words.example: I am preparing for the English test this week.
words.more: prepare for something · preparation (n.)

practice.title_zh: 現在還是通常・分類
practice.note_en: For Dom's Teacher Mystery. Read a sentence, students call out NOW or USUALLY, then say how they knew. The answer is always the signal word.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 Dom 的 Teacher Mystery。唸出句子，學生喊 NOW 或 USUALLY，然後說出他們怎麼知道的。答案永遠是訊號字。
items: I am holding a red pen. → NOW
I drink tea every morning. → USUALLY
I usually arrive at seven thirty. → USUALLY
Right now you are listening to me. → NOW
She is standing by the window. → ？
He often forgets his homework. → ？
We are currently reading a new book. → ？
My father cooks dinner every day. → ？

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese verbs do not move
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文的動詞不動
practice.note_en: Chinese says 他去 whether it is he goes or he is going — the verb never changes and there is no am/is/are. So two errors arrive together this week: the missing -s, and the missing be. Show them side by side.
practice.note_zh: 中文說「他去」，不管是 he goes 還是 he is going，動詞都不變，也沒有 am／is／are。所以這週會同時出現兩種錯：漏掉 -s，和漏掉 be 動詞。把它們並排給學生看。
items: 他每天去學校。 ✗ He go to school every day. ✓ He goes to school every day.
他正在打籃球。 ✗ He playing basketball. ✓ He is playing basketball.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ She study English every night.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ They watching a movie right now.

practice.title_zh: 台灣的星期六，美國的星期六
practice.note_en: Dom's culture connection. Students describe a typical Taiwanese Saturday in the present simple, then say what they are doing this particular Saturday in the continuous. Same day, two tenses.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的文化連結。學生先用現在簡單式描述台灣典型的星期六，再用進行式說「這個」星期六在做什麼。同一天，兩種時態。
items: In Taiwan, students usually ______ on Saturday morning.
Many families often ______ on Saturday evening.
But right now, this Saturday, I am ______.
In the United States, children usually ______ on Saturday. (ask the teacher!)

practice.title_zh: 出場券・兩句
practice.note_en: One habit, one action happening now. The pair is the point — one student, one moment, two tenses.
practice.note_zh: 一句習慣，一句此刻。重點在成對——同一個人、同一個時刻，兩種時態。
items: I usually ______ after school.
But right now I am ______.

6.prep_en: No preparation needed. Five of this week's verbs are irregular and three are regular -ed — worth sorting on the board before anything else, because that split is the whole difficulty of the past simple.
6.prep_zh: 不必備課。本週五個動詞是不規則、三個是規則加 -ed——先在白板上分成兩堆，因為過去式的難處全在這條分界線上。

words.example: We went to Lukang last Sunday.
words.more: 不規則　go → went → gone

words.example: I saw my teacher at the night market.
words.more: 不規則　see → saw → seen

words.example: My grandmother made rice dumplings.
words.more: 不規則　make → made → made

words.example: He took the train to Taichung.
words.more: 不規則　take → took → taken

words.example: I felt nervous before the speech.
words.more: 不規則　feel → felt → felt

words.example: We visited my aunt in Kaohsiung.
words.more: 規則 +ed　字尾唸 /ɪd/

words.example: Something strange happened on the bus.
words.more: 規則 +ed　字尾唸 /d/

words.example: We decided to walk home.
words.more: 規則 +ed　字尾唸 /ɪd/

practice.title_zh: 週末偵探・六條線索
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs clues, so here they are. Hand them out in order, one at a time. After all six, each team tells the whole story in the past tense — that telling is the real exercise.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要線索，這裡備好了。一次發一條，照順序。六條發完後，每組用過去式把整個故事講一遍——講的那一段才是真正的練習。
items: Clue 1　On Saturday morning, Mei-Ling took the 7:40 train.
Clue 2　She carried an enormous box and a small umbrella.
Clue 3　At 9:00 the box was empty.
Clue 4　A stranger at the station saw her laughing.
Clue 5　She got home with no umbrella and a puppy.
Clue 6　Her mother was not surprised.
Now tell the story: What happened on Saturday? (at least 8 past-tense verbs)

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese marks time once
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文只標一次時間
practice.note_en: Chinese puts the pastness in 了 or in a time word, and the verb never moves. English moves the verb — but only once. So two opposite errors appear: no past at all, and past marked twice.
practice.note_zh: 中文把過去放在「了」或時間詞上，動詞本身不動。英文是動詞要變——但只變一次。所以會出現兩種相反的錯：完全沒變，和變了兩次。
items: 我昨天去學校。 ✗ Yesterday I go to school. ✓ Yesterday I went to school.
你昨天去了嗎？ ✗ Did you went? ✓ Did you go?　(did 已經扛了過去)
Your turn — fix this: ✗ She didn't saw the message.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Last week we visit my grandmother.

practice.title_zh: -ed 有三種唸法
practice.note_en: Students write -ed correctly and then say it wrong. The ending follows the sound before it — no need to memorize lists, just feel where the mouth is.
practice.note_zh: 學生 -ed 寫得對，唸出來卻錯。字尾的唸法由前一個音決定——不必背清單，感覺一下嘴巴在哪裡就知道。
items: /ɪd/ after t or d → visited · decided · wanted · needed
/t/ after a voiceless sound → watched · walked · asked · finished
/d/ after everything else → happened · played · listened · called
Say them across: visited-watched-happened. Feel the difference?

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句真的事
practice.note_en: Something that really happened last weekend, with one irregular verb underlined. True beats clever.
practice.note_zh: 上週末真的發生的一件事，畫出其中一個不規則動詞。真實比漂亮重要。
items: Last weekend I ______.
Underline the irregular verb you used.

7.prep_en: No preparation needed. The whole week hangs on one contrast: the long action in the background (was doing) and the short action that cuts across it (did). Draw a long line on the board and a short arrow through it — that drawing is the grammar.
7.prep_zh: 不必備課。整週只靠一組對比：背景那個長動作（was doing），和橫切過去的短動作（did）。在白板上畫一條長線，再畫一支箭穿過去——那張圖就是文法。

words.example: I was reading when the phone rang.
words.more: I/he/she/it → was　you/we/they → were

words.example: While I was cooking, my brother was singing.
words.more: while 後面通常接 was/were + -ing

words.example: I was walking home when it started to rain.
words.more: when 後面通常接過去簡單式

words.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.
words.more: 放句首製造戲劇效果

words.example: Meanwhile, her sister was still sleeping.
words.more: 連接兩個同時進行的場景

words.example: What happened while I was away?
words.more: happen → happened（規則）

words.example: A loud knock interrupted our meeting.
words.more: interrupt → interruption (n.)

words.example: Nobody noticed that the door was open.
words.more: notice → noticed（規則）

practice.title_zh: 定格・五個背景
practice.note_en: For Dom's activity. Read the background, students supply the interruption. The background stays in was/were + -ing; the interruption jumps to past simple. Worked example first.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 Dom 的活動。老師唸背景，學生補上打斷。背景維持 was/were + -ing，打斷跳到過去簡單式。先看示範。
items: Example: I was eating my lunch when a monkey took my banana.
We were practicing for the concert when ______.
While the teacher was writing on the board, ______.
My father was driving home when ______.
The whole class was taking a test when ______.
While we were waiting for the bus, ______.

practice.title_en: The trap · one Chinese word, two English ones
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文一個詞，英文兩個
practice.note_en: Chinese uses 的時候 for both. English splits it: while for the long action, when for the short one. If both actions are long, while works for both. If both are short, use when.
practice.note_zh: 中文兩種情況都用「的時候」。英文分家了：while 給長動作，when 給短動作。兩個都長，兩個都用 while；兩個都短，用 when。
items: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。 ✓ I was taking a shower when the phone rang.　(長 → when 接短)
我在洗澡的時候我弟在唱歌。 ✓ While I was taking a shower, my brother was singing.　(兩個都長)
Your turn — fix this: ✗ While the phone rang, I was cooking.
Your turn — choose: I ______ (walk) to school when I ______ (see) my teacher.

practice.title_zh: 萬聖節的打斷
practice.note_en: Dom's Halloween week. Spooky but gentle — the sillier the interruption, the better the grammar sticks.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的萬聖節週。嚇人但別嚇壞——打斷越荒謬，文法記得越牢。
items: I was walking past the old temple when ______.
While my sister was watching a scary movie, ______.
We were handing out candy when suddenly ______.
Meanwhile, in the kitchen, the dog was ______.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個被打斷的瞬間
practice.note_en: One sentence, both tenses, and it has to be true.
practice.note_zh: 一句話，兩種時態，而且要是真的。

8.vocab_label_zh: 10 個字 · 6 個過去分詞 + 4 個訊號字
8.prep_en: No preparation needed, but read the trap card before you teach — the present perfect is the single hardest tense for Chinese speakers, and the reason is specific: 過 and 了 look alike in Chinese and land in different English tenses.
8.prep_zh: 不必備課，但教之前先看一眼陷阱卡——現在完成式是中文母語者最難的一個時態，原因很具體：中文的「過」和「了」長得像，在英文裡卻落在不同的時態。

words.example: I have visited Tainan three times.
words.more: 規則　visit → visited → visited

words.example: Have you ever eaten stinky tofu?
words.more: 不規則　eat → ate → eaten

words.example: She has seen that movie twice.
words.more: 不規則　see → saw → seen

words.example: We have tried making mooncakes at home.
words.more: 規則　try → tried → tried（y 變 i）

words.example: I have already finished my homework.
words.more: 規則　finish → finished → finished

words.example: He has forgotten his umbrella again.
words.more: 不規則　forget → forgot → forgotten

words.example: Have you ever climbed Jade Mountain?
words.more: 只用在問句　Have you ever…?

words.example: I have never been to Japan.
words.more: 本身就是否定，不要再加 not

words.example: We have already eaten lunch.
words.more: 放在 have 和分詞中間

words.example: I haven't finished it yet.
words.more: 用在否定句與問句 · 放句尾

practice.title_zh: 你曾經…？・全班賓果
practice.note_en: Dom asks for bingo, so here is a grid. Students move around, ask the full question, and write a name in a square only after asking one follow-up question. The follow-up is where the real English happens.
practice.note_zh: Dom 要賓果，這裡備好九宮格。學生走動、問完整的問句，追問一題之後才能在格子裡寫名字。追問的那一句才是真正在說英文。
items: …eaten stinky tofu?　|　…visited Taipei 101?　|　…forgotten your homework?
…seen a typhoon?　|　…tried surfing?　|　…met a foreigner before?
…climbed a mountain?　|　…cooked for your family?　|　…been on a night train?
Follow-up must be past simple: When did you…? / How was it? / Who did you go with?

practice.title_en: The trap · 過 and 了 go to different tenses
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・「過」和「了」去了不同的時態
practice.note_en: 過 is experience with no date — that is the present perfect. 了 with a finished time is the past simple. The rule that follows: the present perfect can never sit next to a finished past time. Say 'no dates allowed' and students remember it.
practice.note_zh: 「過」是沒有日期的經驗——那是現在完成式。「了」加上結束的時間點，那是過去簡單式。由此得出一條規則：現在完成式旁邊不能放結束了的時間。告訴學生「完成式不准帶日期」，他們就記得住。
items: 我去過日本。（經驗） ✓ I have been to Japan.
我去年去了日本。（有時間） ✓ I went to Japan last year.
✗ I have gone to Japan last year.　← 完成式不准帶日期
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I have seen that movie yesterday.
Your turn — choose: She ______ (finish) her report already.

practice.title_en: Where the four signal words sit
practice.title_zh: 四個訊號字站在哪裡
practice.note_en: Position is half the battle. ever and already go inside, between have and the participle; yet goes to the end; never replaces the not.
practice.note_zh: 位置就是一半的勝負。ever 和 already 站在中間，夾在 have 和分詞之間；yet 站句尾；never 本身就是否定，不要再加 not。
items: Have you ever eaten it?　　(ever 在中間)
I have already eaten it.　　(already 在中間)
I haven't eaten it yet.　　(yet 在句尾)
I have never eaten it.　　(never 取代 not)
✗ I haven't never eaten it.　← 一個句子只要一個否定

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one experience, one date
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個經驗，一個日期
practice.note_en: The pair proves they see the difference. Same event, two tenses, and the second one must carry a time.
practice.note_zh: 成對出現才證明他們看懂了差別。同一件事，兩種時態，第二句一定要帶時間。
items: I have ______ .　(no date allowed)
I ______ last ______ .　(with a date)

9.prep_en: No preparation needed. Four of Dom's five verbs end their third form in -en — that is not a coincidence, it is a family. Point that out and fifteen forms become five patterns.
9.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 給的五個動詞裡有四個第三態以 -en 結尾——那不是巧合，是一個家族。把這件事點破，十五個形式就變成五個規律。

words.example: She has gone to the library. (她人還在那裡)
words.more: 自成一格 · 注意 been 和 gone 不同：have been = 去過回來了

words.example: We have eaten all the mooncakes.
words.more: -en 家族

words.example: He has written three letters this week.
words.more: -en 家族 · 注意雙寫 tt

words.example: Someone has broken the window.
words.more: -en 家族 · 也常用在被動：The window was broken.

words.example: They have chosen the winning team.
words.more: -en 家族 · choose(現在) 兩個 o，chose(過去) 一個

practice.title_zh: 第三態錦標賽・題庫
practice.note_en: Dom's race needs verbs, so here are twelve. Teams call out all three forms; a point for the set, a bonus point for a correct sentence using the third form.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的競賽需要題目，這裡備了十二個。各組喊出三態；答對一組得一分，能用第三態造出正確句子再加一分。
items: (Answers: spoke/spoken · took/taken · gave/given · saw/seen · drove/driven · forgot/forgotten · sang/sung · drank/drunk · began/begun · swam/swum · cut/cut · put/put)

practice.title_zh: 三個家族，不是三十個動詞
practice.note_en: Memorizing a list of thirty is miserable. Sorting them into three shapes is a puzzle. Give students the three patterns and let them file the verbs themselves.
practice.note_zh: 背三十個字很痛苦，把它們歸進三種形狀卻像解謎。給學生三種規律，讓他們自己把動詞歸檔。
items: ① -en 家族：eat-ate-eaten · write-wrote-written · break-broke-broken · choose-chose-chosen · give-gave-given
② i–a–u 家族：sing-sang-sung · drink-drank-drunk · begin-began-begun · swim-swam-swum
③ 三態相同：cut-cut-cut · put-put-put · hit-hit-hit · let-let-let
Which family does 'ring' belong to? And 'shut'?

practice.title_en: The trap · the second form is not the third
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・第二態不等於第三態
practice.note_en: Chinese has one form per verb; English asks for three, and the second and third look similar enough to blur. After have / has / had, it must be the third. Write 'have + ③' on the board and leave it there all lesson.
practice.note_zh: 中文一個動詞只有一個樣子，英文要三個，而第二態和第三態長得夠像，學生會混。have／has／had 後面一定是第三態。在白板寫下「have + ③」，整堂課都不要擦掉。
items: ✗ I have went to Taipei. ✓ I have gone to Taipei.
✗ She has ate already. ✓ She has eaten already.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ They have wrote the report.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ He has broke his glasses.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · start the Top 30 chart
practice.title_zh: 出場券・開始做三十個動詞表
practice.note_en: Dom's homework is a personal Top 30 chart. Start it here so nobody goes home unsure what it looks like — three columns, five rows, done in class.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業是做一張自己的三十動詞表。在課堂上先起頭，沒有人會回家後不知道該長什麼樣——三欄五列，當場完成。
items: Draw three columns: base / past / past participle.
Fill five verbs you will actually use this week.
Write one sentence with a third form: I have ______ .

10.prep_en: No preparation needed. This is the review week, so the nine words are all time signals — each one points at a tense. Teach the signals and the review teaches itself.
10.prep_zh: 不必備課。這是複習週，所以九個字全是時間訊號——每一個都指向一種時態。把訊號教好，複習就自己完成了。

words.example: I finished the book yesterday.
words.more: → 過去簡單式

words.example: We moved here three years ago.
words.more: → 過去簡單式 · 放在時間長度後面

words.example: While I was studying, it started to rain.
words.more: → 過去進行式

words.example: I usually walk to school.
words.more: → 現在簡單式

words.example: Now I am reading a longer book.
words.more: → 現在進行式

words.example: I have studied English since third grade.
words.more: → 現在完成式 · since + 起點

words.example: I have studied English for six years.
words.more: → 現在完成式 · for + 長度

words.example: She has already left.
words.more: → 現在完成式

words.example: We have recently started a new project.
words.more: → 現在完成式

practice.title_zh: 用哪個時態？・三個問題
practice.note_en: Not a rule to memorize — a path to walk. Ask the three questions in order and the tense falls out. Put this on the board and leave it up for the rest of the year.
practice.note_zh: 這不是要背的規則，是一條可以走的路。照順序問三個問題，時態自己就掉出來了。把它寫在白板上，接下來一整年都留著。
items: ① Is it finished? No → is it happening right now? Yes → am/is/are + -ing. No → present simple.
② Is it finished? Yes → do you say when? Yes → past simple.
③ Finished but no date, or still true today? → have/has + third form.
Test it: 我學英文六年了。→ still true today → I have studied English for six years.

practice.title_zh: 時光機・四個區
practice.note_en: Dom's game. Mark four corners of the room. Call a zone, students move and must speak in the matching tense within five seconds. Anyone who uses the wrong tense goes back to the middle.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的遊戲。在教室四角標出四個區。喊一個區，學生移動過去，五秒內用對應時態說一句話。用錯時態的回到中間。
items: Corner 1　YESTERDAY → past simple　(I ate breakfast at seven.)
Corner 2　RIGHT NOW → present continuous　(I am standing in the corner.)
Corner 3　IN MY LIFE → present perfect　(I have visited Kenting twice.)
Corner 4　WHEN I WAS YOUNGER → past simple / used to　(I played every afternoon.)

practice.title_zh: since 還是 for？
practice.note_en: Both become 了 in Chinese, so students guess. since takes a point on the calendar; for takes a length. If you can answer 'when did it start?', use since. If you can answer 'how long?', use for.
practice.note_zh: 兩個在中文裡都變成「了」，所以學生只能猜。since 接日曆上的一點，for 接一段長度。能回答「什麼時候開始的」用 since，能回答「多久」用 for。
items: ______ 2020　·　______ six years　·　______ I was eight　·　______ a long time
______ last summer　·　______ three months　·　______ Monday　·　______ ten minutes
Your turn: 我在這間學校待了三年。→ I have been at this school ______ three years.
Your turn: 我從三年級就住在彰化。→ I have lived in Changhua ______ third grade.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・2026 時光膠囊
practice.note_en: Dom's seasonal reset. Four sentences, four tenses, sealed and opened at the end of the year. This doubles as the start of the homework timeline.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的季節重整。四句話、四種時態，封起來、年底再打開。這也正好是回家作業那張時間軸的開頭。
items: I usually ______ .　(現在簡單式)
Right now I am ______ .　(現在進行式)
Last month I ______ .　(過去簡單式)
So far this year I have ______ .　(現在完成式)

11.prep_en: No preparation needed. Week 4 was about climbing to a stronger word. This week is the opposite lesson: synonyms are not spare parts. Each one has a place it belongs and places it does not.
11.prep_zh: 不必備課。第 4 週學的是往上換一個更強的字，這週剛好相反：同義詞不是零件，不能隨便替換。每個字都有它待得住的地方，和待不住的地方。

words.example: She is a happy person.
words.more: 組 ①　最通用 · 可以形容「一個人」

words.example: I'm glad you came.
words.more: 只用在特定事件 · ✗ a glad person

words.example: The teacher was pleased with our report.
words.more: 對結果滿意 · 稍正式 · pleased with

words.example: We were delighted to hear the news.
words.more: 最強 · 正式場合、書信常用

words.example: He is a smart student.
words.more: 組 ②　最通用 · 美式口語

words.example: That was a clever way to solve it.
words.more: 有巧思 · 形容「方法」比形容人安全（形容人有時帶狡猾意味）

words.example: She asked an intelligent question.
words.more: 正式 · 指理解力，不用來誇小聰明

words.example: I was irritated by the noise.
words.more: 組 ③　最輕 · 被煩到

words.example: My father was angry about the broken window.
words.more: 中等 · 最通用

words.example: She was furious when she saw the mess.
words.more: 最強 · 不能再加 very

practice.title_zh: 同義詞快閃・題目表
practice.note_en: Dom's race. Call a basic word; the first student to answer must give a synonym AND use it in a sentence. A synonym without a sentence scores nothing — that rule is what stops this becoming a memory test.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的競賽。老師喊一個基本字，最快搶答的學生要給同義詞「並且」造句。只給字不造句不算分——這條規則才能讓它不淪為背誦測驗。
items: happy → ______
smart → ______
angry → ______
tired → ______
scary → ______
important → ______

practice.title_en: The trap · one Chinese word, several English ones
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文一個字，英文好幾個
practice.note_en: 「聰明」covers smart, clever and intelligent, so students assume the three are interchangeable. They are not — English fixes each one to certain partners. Test by collocation, not by meaning.
practice.note_zh: 「聰明」一個字涵蓋 smart、clever、intelligent，所以學生以為三個可以互換。不行——英文把每個字綁在固定的搭配上。要用搭配去測，不是用意思去測。
items: ✗ He is a glad person. ✓ He is a happy person. ✓ I'm glad you came.
✗ What an intelligent trick! ✓ What a clever trick!
Your turn — choose: I was very ______ (irritated / furious) by the small noise.
Your turn — choose: We are ______ (glad / delighted) to invite you to our ceremony.

practice.title_zh: 哪一個放得進去？
practice.note_en: Read the sentence, students pick from the week's ten words and say why. 'It sounds better' does not count; the reason must be about strength or about who or what the word is describing.
practice.note_zh: 唸句子，學生從本週十個字裡挑，並說出理由。「聽起來比較好」不算；理由必須是強度，或這個字在形容誰、形容什麼。
items: My little sister broke my model. I was ______ .
Someone stole my bicycle. I was ______ .
The principal was ______ with our SDG poster.
She found a ______ way to carry all the books at once.
We are ______ to announce the winner. (正式)

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · same word, two feelings
practice.title_zh: 出場券・同一組字，兩種感覺
practice.note_en: This is Dom's homework in miniature: two sentences that show the difference, not two sentences that use the words.
practice.note_zh: 這是 Dom 作業的縮小版：兩句話要讓差別現出來，不是只把字用進去。
items: I was irritated when ______ .
I was furious when ______ .

12.prep_en: No preparation needed. Two kinds of opposite live in this week: the ones English builds with a prefix (happy / unhappy) and the ones that are a different word altogether (arrive / depart). Students reach for the prefix every time, so sort the two kinds first.
12.prep_zh: 不必備課。本週有兩種相反：一種是英文用字首造出來的（happy / unhappy），一種根本是另一個字（arrive / depart）。學生每次都伸手去拿字首，所以先把兩種分開。

words.example: Lukang has many ancient buildings.
words.more: 組 ①　↔ modern · 不是 unmodern

words.example: Taipei 101 is a modern landmark.
words.more: ↔ ancient

words.example: Our neighbor is very generous with her time.
words.more: 組 ②　↔ selfish

words.example: It was selfish to take all the snacks.
words.more: ↔ generous · 注意：unselfish 也存在，但 selfish 才是真正的反義

words.example: The school will expand the library next year.
words.more: 組 ③　↔ contract · expansion (n.)

words.example: Metal contracts when it gets cold.
words.more: ↔ expand · 這個字也可以當名詞「合約」

words.example: The number of students increased this year.
words.more: 組 ④　↔ decrease

words.example: Rainfall decreased in August.
words.more: ↔ increase · 寫報告、看圖表時最常用的一對

words.example: The train arrives at nine.
words.more: 組 ⑤　↔ depart · arrive at 小地方 / arrive in 大城市

words.example: The bus departs from platform two.
words.more: ↔ arrive · 車站機場的正式用字 · departure (n.)

practice.title_en: Opposite Day · silly first, serious after
practice.title_zh: 相反日・先荒謬，後正經
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Students answer with the opposite of the truth, and the class corrects them. The silliness lowers the fear; the second round is where the learning is banked.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。學生用「跟事實相反」的答案回答，全班糾正。荒謬降低恐懼，第二輪才是把學習存進去的地方。
items: Is the classroom quiet right now?  (相反：Yes, it's extremely quiet.)
Is Taipei 101 an ancient building?
Did you arrive at school yesterday, or depart?
Is our class getting bigger or smaller this year?
Now switch to serious: give one true sentence with each pair.

practice.title_en: The trap · un- does not fit everything
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・un- 不是萬用
practice.note_en: Chinese makes almost every opposite with 不. English has four prefixes plus a large pile of words that take none at all. When in doubt, a different word is safer than a guessed prefix.
practice.note_zh: 中文幾乎所有相反都用「不」。英文有四個字首，外加一大堆根本不加字首的字。不確定的時候，換一個字比亂猜字首安全。
items: un- → happy/unhappy · fair/unfair · lucky/unlucky
dis- → agree/disagree · honest/dishonest · appear/disappear
im- / in- → possible/impossible · correct/incorrect · polite/impolite
✗ unpossible ✗ uncorrect ✗ unagree ✗ unarrive
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I unagree with that plan.

practice.title_zh: 對比的說法・however、whereas、while
practice.note_en: Dom's CEFR line asks B2+ students for these three. They are how an opposite becomes an argument. Pair with her National Day connection — compare respectfully, without ranking one place above another.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的 CEFR 欄要求 B2 以上要會這三個。它們是把「相反」變成「論述」的工具。搭配她指定的國慶連結——尊重地比較，不要把某個地方排在另一個之上。
items: Lukang is ancient; Taipei, however, is modern.
Whereas the north is crowded, the east coast is quiet.
While some families celebrate at home, others go to the parade.
Your turn: Taiwan ______ , whereas the United States ______ .

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one pair, one contrast
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一組相反，一句對比
practice.note_en: One sentence holding both halves of a pair. If they can join the two with however or whereas, that is a bonus point.
practice.note_zh: 一句話裡放進一組相反的兩半。能用 however 或 whereas 接起來的加一分。

13.prep_en: No preparation needed. Week 4 asked students to climb to a stronger word. This week asks something harder: know the whole ladder, and know that the top rung will not take 'very'.
13.prep_zh: 不必備課。第 4 週要學生往上換一個更強的字，這週要求更難的事：認得整道梯子，並且知道最高那一階「不接 very」。

words.example: I was annoyed by the noise upstairs.
words.more: 量尺 ①　輕

words.example: He was angry about the unfair result.
words.more: 中

words.example: She was absolutely furious.
words.more: 極端字 · 不加 very，要加 absolutely

words.example: The classroom is warm today.
words.more: 量尺 ②　輕

words.example: August in Changhua is very hot.
words.more: 中

words.example: It was absolutely boiling on the bus.
words.more: 極端字 · ✗ very boiling

words.example: The lunch was good.
words.more: 量尺 ③　輕

words.example: That was a great performance.
words.more: 中

words.example: Her handwriting is exceptional.
words.more: 極端字 · 正式 · ✗ very exceptional

practice.title_zh: 單字溫度計
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Draw a thermometer on the board. Hand out the words shuffled; students place each one and must defend the position. Arguments about placement are the lesson, not a delay.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。在白板畫一支溫度計，把字打散發下去，學生一個個貼上並說明理由。為了位置吵起來就是這堂課的重點，不是浪費時間。
items: Set A: cool · cold · freezing · chilly
Set B: like · love · adore · enjoy
Set C: small · tiny · little · microscopic
Set D: tired · sleepy · exhausted
Rule: whoever places a word must say what is one step below it.

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・極端字不收 very
practice.note_en: Chinese happily says 非常暴怒. English does not: furious, boiling, exceptional, freezing and exhausted already contain the 'very'. They take absolutely or completely instead. This single rule makes a student sound years more advanced.
practice.note_zh: 中文可以說「非常暴怒」，英文不行：furious、boiling、exceptional、freezing、exhausted 裡面已經含著 very 了。它們要接 absolutely 或 completely。光這一條規則，就能讓學生聽起來成熟好幾年。
items: ✗ very furious ✓ absolutely furious
✗ very boiling ✓ absolutely boiling
✗ very exhausted ✓ completely exhausted
✓ very angry · very hot · very tired　← 中間那一階可以接 very
Your turn — fix this: ✗ The soup was very boiling and I was very exhausted.

practice.title_zh: 看球的反應・從平淡到瘋狂
practice.note_en: Dom's sports connection. Give the scale, then call out moments from a game; students respond at the right temperature. Shouting 'ecstatic' at a warm-up throw is the mistake to catch.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的運動連結。先給量尺，再喊出比賽片段，學生用對的溫度回應。熱身傳球就喊 ecstatic，正是要抓的錯。
items: interested → keen → excited → thrilled → ecstatic
The team walks onto the field. → ?
Your school scores the first point. → ?
Your school wins the county championship. → ?
The other team scores. → annoyed / angry / furious?

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · build your own scale
practice.title_zh: 出場券・自己做一道量尺
practice.note_en: Four words on one idea, weakest to strongest, plus one sentence using the top rung correctly. Dom's homework asks for five scales, so this is the first one done in class.
practice.note_zh: 同一個概念找四個字，由弱排到強，再用最強那一階造一句正確的話。Dom 的作業要五道量尺，這是在課堂上先做掉的第一道。
items: Sentence with the strongest word: ______

14.prep_en: This is the most valuable week of the whole unit for Chinese speakers, and the reason is blunt: every single pair here is ONE word in Chinese. 借 is both borrow and lend. 看 is look, see and watch. 做 is make and do. The students are not being careless — their first language never asked them to choose. Teach the choosing.
14.prep_zh: 對中文母語者來說，這是整個單元最值錢的一週，理由很直白：這裡每一組在中文裡都只有一個字。「借」同時是 borrow 和 lend，「看」同時是 look、see、watch，「做」同時是 make 和 do。學生不是粗心——他們的母語從來沒要求他們做這個選擇。要教的就是這個選擇。

words.example: Can I borrow your eraser?
words.more: ① 我拿進來 · borrow FROM someone

words.example: Can you lend me your eraser?
words.more: 我給出去 · lend TO someone · 中文都叫「借」

words.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow.
words.more: ② 往說話的人這邊移動

words.example: Take an umbrella with you.
words.more: 離開說話的人 · 方向決定用哪個字

words.example: She said hello.
words.more: ③ 後面接「話」· 不必接人 · ✗ say me

words.example: She told me the answer.
words.more: 後面一定接「人」· tell someone something

words.example: I heard a strange noise last night.
words.more: ④ 聲音自己進來的 · 不是你決定的

words.example: Listen to this song.
words.more: 你決定去聽 · listen TO · 少了 to 就錯

words.example: Look at the board.
words.more: ⑤ 動作 · look AT

words.example: I see a bird on the roof.
words.more: 結果 · 不是你努力來的

words.example: We watched the whole baseball game.
words.more: 會動的東西、看一段時間

words.example: My grandmother makes excellent dumplings.
words.more: ⑥ 做完會多出一個東西來

words.example: I do my homework after dinner.
words.more: 做完沒有多出東西 · 搭配要背

words.example: Everyone makes mistakes.
words.more: 固定搭配：make a mistake（不是 do）

practice.title_en: The English Courtroom · which word is guilty?
practice.title_zh: 英文法庭・哪個字有罪？
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Read the sentence aloud; the class decides which word is guilty and passes sentence — that is, gives the correction and the reason. The reason is what convicts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。唸出句子，全班判定哪個字有罪並「宣判」——也就是給出更正和理由。有理由才算定罪。
items: Can you borrow me five dollars?
My mother said me to clean my room.
I'm hearing to music right now.
Did you watch my keys? I can't find them.
Please bring this letter to the post office on your way home.
I need to make my homework before dinner.
He looked a bird in the tree.
I will take my friend to your party next week. (有罪嗎？)

practice.title_en: One Chinese word, two English ones
practice.title_zh: 中文一個字，英文兩個
practice.note_en: The master table. Copy it to the board and leave it up all lesson. Each line is a question the student must now answer that Chinese never asked: which direction, who is involved, did you choose it.
practice.note_zh: 總表。抄到白板上，整堂課都留著。每一行都是一個中文從來不問、但學生現在得回答的問題：往哪個方向、牽涉到誰、是不是你自己要的。
items: 借 → borrow（我拿進來）/ lend（我給出去）：誰移動？
帶 → bring（往這裡）/ take（往那裡）：哪個方向？
說 → say（說了什麼）/ tell（告訴了誰）：有沒有接人？
聽 → hear（自己進來）/ listen to（我要聽）：是不是你決定的？
看 → look at（轉過去）/ see（看見了）/ watch（看一段時間）
做 → make（多出一個東西）/ do（沒有多出東西）

practice.title_zh: make 還是 do？・固定搭配
practice.note_en: This pair cannot be reasoned out to the end — the last stretch is memory. Teach the rule first (make leaves something behind), then drill the exceptions as a chant.
practice.note_zh: 這一組沒辦法完全用道理推到底，最後一段就是要記。先教規則（make 會留下一個東西），再把例外當口訣練。
items: make → a cake · a mistake · friends · noise · a decision · money · a plan
do → homework · the dishes · exercise · your best · business · a favor
Your turn: I ______ my best but I still ______ two mistakes.
Your turn: Let's ______ a plan and then ______ the work.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一段小對話
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks for twelve mini-dialogues, so write the first one here. Two lines, one confusing pair used correctly in each.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要十二段小對話，第一段在這裡寫掉。兩句話，每句正確用到一組易混字。

15.prep_en: No preparation needed — the boring paragraph is written below, ready to hand out. This week is not about knowing more words; it is about the word that fits. Precision beats strength.
15.prep_zh: 不必備課——那段故意寫得很無聊的文章已經備在下面，可以直接發。這週不是要學更多字，是要找到「剛好對」的那個字。精準勝過強烈。

words.example: The old street looked beautiful at night.
words.more: 最通用的「美」

words.example: The view from the mountain was stunning.
words.more: 很強 · 多半用在看得見的東西 · 極端字，不加 very

words.example: She wore an elegant dark blue dress.
words.more: 簡潔又講究 · 衣服、設計、解法都可以

words.example: The east coast has dramatic cliffs.
words.more: 落差大、有衝擊力 · 風景、變化

words.example: It was an ordinary Tuesday.
words.more: 中性偏平淡 · ↔ unusual

words.example: That is an unusual name.
words.more: ↔ ordinary · 不帶好壞

words.example: Winning three medals is impressive.
words.more: 用在成就、技術、規模

words.example: The ending was disappointing.
words.more: -ing 是「令人…」· disappointed 才是「（人）感到…」

practice.title_zh: 爛段落大改造・病人在此
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs a bad paragraph, so here is one, written badly on purpose. Hand it out, give each team six minutes, then read the versions aloud. The class votes — but a team only wins if it can say why each change is better.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要一段爛文章，這裡故意寫了一段。發下去，每組六分鐘，然後各組唸出自己的版本。全班投票——但要說得出每個更動為什麼更好，才算贏。
items: Last week I went to a place. The food was good. There were a lot of people.
The building was big and old. We took some photos. It was a good day.
I was happy. The weather was nice. I want to go again.
Targets: replace every 'good' · name the place · make one sentence longer than twelve words · use two words from this week.

practice.title_zh: 哪個字配哪個字？
practice.note_en: Collocation, not meaning. All eight words mean roughly nice or not nice; only some of them fit each noun. Read the pair aloud — if it sounds odd to you, it is odd.
practice.note_zh: 這是搭配問題，不是意思問題。八個字大致都在講好或不好，但只有某幾個配得上某個名詞。唸出來聽聽看——你覺得怪，它就是怪。
items: ______ cliffs (stunning / elegant / dramatic)
an ______ score in the exam (impressive / beautiful)
an ______ solution to the problem (elegant / stunning)
an ______ ending to the film (disappointing / ordinary)
✗ a beautiful score ✗ an elegant mountain ✗ a dramatic dress　← 為什麼怪？

practice.title_en: -ing or -ed? · the cause or the feeling
practice.title_zh: -ing 還是 -ed？・是原因還是感受
practice.note_en: Back in Week 2 this was exciting and excited. It returns here because it never stops causing trouble: -ing describes the thing, -ed describes the person. Saying 'I am boring' is the classic, and the class will laugh, which helps.
practice.note_zh: 第 2 週的 exciting 和 excited 又回來了。它會回來是因為它從來沒有停止造成麻煩：-ing 形容那個東西，-ed 形容人。說出 I am boring 是經典錯誤，全班會笑——笑了反而記得住。
items: The film was ______ . I was ______ . (disappointing / disappointed)
✗ I am boring. ✓ I am bored. ✓ The lesson is boring.
Your turn: The news was ______ and everyone was ______ . (shocking / shocked)
Your turn: I am ______ in history because history is ______ . (interested / interesting)

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一頓飯，精準地寫
practice.note_en: Dom's November connection is a Thanksgiving-style descriptive paragraph without asking anyone to celebrate it. So: any meal the student remembers, three sentences, no word used twice.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的十一月連結是感恩節式的描寫，但不要求學生真的過這個節。所以改成：任何一頓學生記得的飯，三句話，同一個字不能用兩次。
items: Describe a meal you remember. Three sentences.
Rule: you may not use good, nice or big.
Bonus: use one word from this week.

16.prep_en: No preparation needed. One grammar point carries the whole week, and it is a politeness point too: an embedded question does not invert. 'Where is the gate?' becomes 'Could you tell me where the gate IS?' — the verb goes back to the end. Get that on the board early.
16.prep_zh: 不必備課。整週靠一個文法點撐著，而它同時是禮貌問題：包在句子裡的問句不倒裝。Where is the gate? 變成 Could you tell me where the gate IS? ——動詞退回句尾。這件事早點寫上白板。

words.example: Please have your passport ready.
words.more: 可數 · a passport

words.example: You can show your boarding pass on your phone.
words.more: 兩個字 · 不是 boarding card（英式才這樣說）

words.example: Our flight leaves from gate C7.
words.more: at gate C7 · 不用 the

words.example: I only have one piece of luggage.
words.more: 不可數！✗ two luggages ✓ two pieces of luggage

words.example: I have a reservation under the name Lin.
words.more: make / have / cancel a reservation

words.example: Departures are on the third floor.
words.more: depart (v.) → departure (n.) · 機場看板用複數

words.example: Arrivals is downstairs.
words.more: arrive (v.) → arrival (n.)

words.example: Our flight is delayed by two hours.
words.more: be delayed · delay 也可當名詞：a two-hour delay

practice.title_zh: 桃園飛紐約・六道關卡
practice.note_en: Dom's mission needs problems to solve, so here are six. Hand one to each team in order; they must solve it out loud in English before receiving the next. The trip is the frame, the language is the point.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的任務需要關卡，這裡備了六道。依序發給各組，要用英語說出解法才能拿到下一道。旅程只是框架，語言才是重點。
items: ① The check-in machine will not read your passport. What do you say to the staff?
② Your luggage is two kilograms overweight.
③ You cannot find gate C7. Ask someone — politely.
④ The flight is delayed by three hours. Ask what happens to your connection.
⑤ The person in seat 24B is sitting in your seat.
⑥ You arrive in New York but your luggage does not.

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・客氣的問句要把動詞放回去
practice.note_en: Chinese asks 廁所在哪裡 the same way whether it is polite or not; the politeness is in tone and 請. English rebuilds the sentence instead — and the inside half goes back to statement order. Students who learn this one move sound instantly more fluent.
practice.note_zh: 中文問「廁所在哪裡」，客氣與否只差語氣和一個「請」。英文是把句子重蓋——包在裡面的那半要變回直述句的順序。學生學會這一招，聽起來馬上成熟一截。
items: 直接：Where is the gate?　→　客氣：Could you tell me where the gate is?
✗ Could you tell me where is the gate?　← 裡面那半不可以倒裝
直接：When does the plane leave?　→　Do you know when the plane leaves?
Your turn — make it polite: How much does the ticket cost?
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Do you know what time is it?

practice.title_en: Airport signs you will actually meet
practice.title_zh: 機場真的會遇到的字
practice.note_en: Dom's Taiwan-to-anywhere journey. These are the words on the signs at Taoyuan, in the order you meet them. Walk the class through the airport once before the mission starts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 設計的旅程。這些是桃園機場招牌上真正會出現的字，照遇到的順序排。任務開始前先帶全班走一遍機場。
items: Check-in → Baggage Drop → Security → Immigration → Boarding Gate
Departures（出境）vs Arrivals（入境）· Transfer（轉機）
Now boarding（開始登機）· Final call（最後廣播）· Delayed（延誤）
Listen for: 'Passengers travelling to ______, please proceed to gate ______.'

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個客氣的問句
practice.note_en: One embedded question, written correctly. If the inside half is inverted, it does not count.
practice.note_zh: 寫一個包起來的問句，寫對才算。裡面那半倒裝了就不算。
items: Excuse me, could you tell me ______ ?

17.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom puts count and non-count nouns in this week for a reason: Chinese has no plural -s and counts everything with a measure word (一張、一杯、一個). English splits nouns into two kinds and changes the question word. This is the week to fix 'How many money?' for good.
17.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 把可數與不可數放進這週是有道理的：中文沒有複數 -s，什麼都用量詞數（一張、一杯、一個）。英文把名詞分成兩種，連問句的疑問詞都跟著換。這是把 How many money 徹底改掉的一週。

words.example: The price includes tax.
words.more: 可數 · What's the price? = How much is it?

words.example: Students get a ten percent discount.
words.more: 注意：中文「打八折」= 20% off，不是 80% off

words.example: Keep your receipt if you want to return it.
words.more: p 不發音：/rɪˈsiːt/

words.example: Do you have this in a bigger size?
words.more: What size are you? / in a different size

words.example: Here is your change.
words.more: 這個意思不可數 · ✗ two changes

words.example: Night market food is not expensive.
words.more: 形容「東西」· ✗ The price is expensive ✓ The price is high

words.example: We found an affordable hotel near the station.
words.more: afford (v.) → affordable · I can't afford it

words.example: Buy a small quantity first.
words.more: quantity 數量 · quality 品質 · 兩個字很像，別混

words.example: I don't have enough money.
words.more: 放名詞「前面」，但放形容詞「後面」：enough money / good enough

practice.title_zh: 教室商店・採購清單
practice.note_en: Dom's store needs stock and a silly list. Give each team 500 imaginary dollars and this list; they must buy, ask prices, request a discount and check their change — all in English. Running out of money is part of the fun.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的商店需要商品和一張荒謬的清單。給每組五百元假錢和這張清單，要用英語買東西、問價錢、殺價、確認找零。錢不夠用正是樂趣所在。
items: Shop stock: bubble tea $50 · notebook $35 · umbrella $120 · sneakers $890 · rice ball $25 · headphones $600
Your list: something to drink · something to write with · something for rain · a gift under $100
You must ask: How much is…? · Do you have it in another size? · Is there a discount for students?
Before you leave: Can I have a receipt? · Is this the right change?

practice.title_en: The trap · much, many, and the missing -s
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・much、many，和消失的 -s
practice.note_en: Chinese counts with measure words and never adds -s, so two errors arrive together: the plural goes missing, and much/many gets picked at random. The test is simple — can you put a number directly in front of it?
practice.note_zh: 中文用量詞數數，而且永遠不加 -s，所以兩種錯會一起出現：複數不見了，much／many 也是亂猜的。判準很簡單——這個字前面能不能直接放一個數字？
items: 能放數字 → 可數 → many / a few：three books · many students
不能放數字 → 不可數 → much / a little：✗ three moneys ✓ much money · ✗ two luggages ✓ much luggage
✗ How many money do you have? ✓ How much money do you have?
Your turn — choose: I don't have ______ (much / many) time.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ There were too much people in the store.

practice.title_zh: enough 站在兩邊
practice.note_en: One word, two positions, and Chinese gives no clue which. Before a noun, after an adjective. Say the pair aloud ten times and it sticks.
practice.note_zh: 同一個字，兩種位置，中文完全給不了提示。名詞在後、形容詞在前。把這一對唸個十次就記住了。
items: 名詞 → enough money · enough time · enough seats
形容詞 → good enough · big enough · cheap enough
✗ money enough　✗ enough good
Your turn: This shirt is not ______ ______ for me. (big / enough)

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one thing you cannot afford
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一件你買不起的東西
practice.note_en: Two sentences, one countable noun and one uncountable, used correctly.
practice.note_zh: 兩句話，一個可數名詞、一個不可數名詞，都要用對。
items: I would like to buy ______ , but I don't have enough ______ .

18.prep_en: No preparation needed. The single most useful thing you can teach this week is not a food word — it is that 'I want' does not belong in a restaurant. Chinese 我要一個漢堡 is perfectly polite; the word-for-word English sounds like a small child. Teach 'I'll have' and 'Could I get' in the first ten minutes.
18.prep_zh: 不必備課。這週最有用的不是任何一個食物單字，而是「I want 不能用在餐廳」。中文說「我要一個漢堡」完全禮貌，逐字翻成英文卻像小孩子在講話。前十分鐘就把 I'll have 和 Could I get 教下去。

words.example: What ingredients are in this sauce?
words.more: 可數 · 常用複數

words.example: We ordered two appetizers to share.
words.more: 美式 · 英式說 starter

words.example: My main course was grilled fish.
words.more: 兩個字 · 美式也說 entrée（注意：不是前菜）

words.example: Do you have room for dessert?
words.more: 兩個 s · desert（一個 s）是沙漠

words.example: Is the beef noodle soup very spicy?
words.more: hot 也可以指辣，但 hot 也指燙 · 要講清楚就用 spicy

words.example: Taiwanese sausage is a little sweet.
words.more: 也可以形容人：she is sweet（親切）

words.example: I prefer savory breakfasts to sweet ones.
words.more: 中文沒有完全對應的字 · 就是「不甜、帶鹹香」

words.example: Do you have a vegetarian option?
words.more: vegan 更嚴格（不吃蛋奶）

words.example: I have a peanut allergy.
words.more: allergy (n.) · allergic (adj.)：I'm allergic to peanuts

practice.title_zh: 餐廳角色扮演・附一個意外
practice.note_en: Dom's role-play, with the surprise problems written out. Four roles, and the surprise goes only to the server — nobody else knows it is coming, which is what makes the English real.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的角色扮演，意外事件已經寫好。四個角色，意外只給服務生看——其他人不知道會發生什麼，英語才會是真的。
items: Roles: customer · server · chef · food critic
Surprise ① The dish the customer ordered is sold out.
Surprise ② The food arrives cold.
Surprise ③ There is meat in the vegetarian dish.
Surprise ④ The bill is $200 more than it should be.
The critic must say one kind thing and one honest thing at the end.

practice.title_en: The trap · 'I want' is not for restaurants
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・餐廳裡不說 I want
practice.note_en: This is not grammar, it is register — and register is invisible to a learner. 我要 is neutral in Chinese; I want is blunt in English. The fix is three phrases, and they work in every shop and counter in the world.
practice.note_zh: 這不是文法問題，是語域問題——而語域對學習者是看不見的。中文的「我要」是中性的，英文的 I want 卻很直。解法就三句話，全世界的店和櫃台都通用。
items: ✗ I want a hamburger.　✓ I'll have the hamburger, please.
✓ Could I get the beef noodles?　✓ I'd like the dumplings, please.
Asking: What do you recommend? · What is this dish like?
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I want water. ✗ Give me the bill.

practice.title_zh: 你的雙語菜單・六道菜
practice.note_en: Dom's homework is a menu, so start it here. The hard part is not translating the name — it is describing what is in it so a foreigner can decide. One line each, ingredients plus one taste word.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業是菜單，在這裡先起頭。難的不是翻譯菜名，是描述裡面有什麼、讓外國人能決定要不要點。一道一句，食材加一個味道形容詞。
items: 滷肉飯 → Braised pork rice: rice with savory slow-cooked pork. Not spicy.
臭豆腐 → ______ (warn them!)

practice.title_zh: 出場券・禮貌地點一道菜
practice.note_en: One order and one question. If the order starts with 'I want', it goes back.
practice.note_zh: 一句點餐、一句提問。開頭是 I want 的退回重寫。
items: I'll have ______ , please.
And could you tell me ______ ?

19.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom's own note says it: conversation is more than asking questions. Taiwanese students are often trained to answer and stop, waiting for the next question. English expects the ball to come back. Teach the three-step return and the silence problem disappears.
19.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 自己在教案裡寫了：會話不只是問問題。台灣學生常被訓練成回答完就停下來，等下一個問題。英文期待你把球打回去。教會三步回球法，冷場就不見了。

words.example: Actually, I prefer tea.
words.more: 小心：英文的 actually 常帶「更正對方」的味道 · 不像中文「其實」那麼中性

words.example: Really? That sounds fun.
words.more: 單獨用是最好用的回應詞之一

words.example: That's an interesting way to look at it.
words.more: 小心：單講 interesting 在英語裡常被聽成「我沒意見」

words.example: I like baseball, especially the playoffs.
words.more: 用來把答案加長的好工具

words.example: I prefer coffee to tea.
words.more: prefer A to B · ✗ prefer A than B

words.example: In my opinion, the night market is better.
words.more: in my opinion · ✗ in my opinion think

words.example: Tell me about your experience in Japan.
words.more: 經驗（不可數）/ 一次經歷（可數）都可以

words.example: My hometown is similar to yours.
words.more: similar TO · ✗ similar with

practice.title_zh: 三步回球法
practice.note_en: The whole week in one move. Answer, add something nobody asked for, then ask back. Students who only do step one will never sustain a conversation, no matter how good their grammar is.
practice.note_zh: 整週的重點就這一招。回答、加一句沒人問你的話、再問回去。只做第一步的學生，文法再好也撐不起一段對話。
items: Q: Do you like basketball?
① 回答　Yes, I do.
② 加料　Especially the school team — I go to every home game.
③ 回球　What about you? Do you play anything?
Practice: Do you have any brothers or sisters? → build all three steps.

practice.title_zh: 會話旋轉木馬・題目
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Sixty seconds per partner, then rotate. The rule that makes it work: afterwards each student must recall one detail about every person they spoke to — so they have to listen, not just wait for their turn.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。每位夥伴六十秒，然後輪轉。讓它有效的規則是：結束後每個學生要說出每位談話對象的一個細節——所以他們必須聽，而不是等著輪到自己講。
items: What is something you are good at that most people don't know?
What did you eat for breakfast, and was it a good decision?
Where would you take a foreign visitor in Changhua?
What is a small thing that always makes you happy?
Do you prefer the mountains or the sea? Why?
Recall round: name one detail about each person you met.

practice.title_en: The trap · two words that backfire
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・兩個會反效果的字
practice.note_en: These two travel straight from Chinese and land wrong. 其實 is a neutral softener in Chinese; 'actually' in English often means 'no, you are mistaken'. And a flat 'interesting' is heard by native speakers as polite disagreement, not interest.
practice.note_zh: 這兩個字從中文直接搬過來，落地就歪了。中文的「其實」是中性的緩衝詞，英文的 actually 常常等於「不，你搞錯了」。而平板地說一句 interesting，母語者聽到的是委婉的不同意，不是有興趣。
items: 中性想說「其實我比較喜歡茶」→ 更安全：I think I prefer tea, actually. / To be honest, I prefer tea.
想表示有興趣 → ✗ Interesting.　✓ That's interesting — how did that happen?
Rule: 'interesting' needs a follow-up question attached, or it sounds like a full stop.
Your turn: 你朋友說他討厭夏天。用三步回球法回應。

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個真的問題
practice.note_en: An open question they would actually ask a stranger — not one from a textbook. Dom's homework needs eight of these; this is the first.
practice.note_zh: 寫一個他們真的會拿去問陌生人的開放式問題，不是課本上那種。Dom 的作業要八個，這是第一個。
items: My question: ______ ?
(No yes/no questions — it must open something up.)

20.prep_en: No preparation needed, but this is the week to say the thing out loud that explains the whole unit: in English, politeness is built with grammar, not with tone. The longer and more indirect the sentence, the more polite it sounds. Chinese does it with 請 and with how you say it. That difference is why a fluent student can still sound rude.
20.prep_zh: 不必備課，但這是該把整個單元的道理講明的一週：英文的禮貌是用文法蓋出來的，不是用語氣。句子越長、越間接，聽起來越客氣。中文靠「請」和說話的方式。這個差別，正是為什麼一個講得很流利的學生還是可能聽起來很兇。

words.example: There is a problem with my order.
words.more: a problem with something · question 是「疑問」，不一樣

words.example: Can you suggest a solution?
words.more: a solution to a problem · solve (v.)

words.example: The screen is broken.
words.more: break → broke → broken（第 9 週的三態）

words.example: One page is missing from the book.
words.more: be missing · 不說 lost 除非是人或路

words.example: Could I get a refund, please?
words.more: get / ask for a refund

words.example: Could you replace it with a new one?
words.more: replace A with B · replacement (n.)

words.example: They apologized for the delay.
words.more: apologize for something · apology (n.)

words.example: What would you recommend?
words.more: ✗ recommend me to · ✓ recommend something to me

practice.title_zh: 禮貌階梯
practice.note_en: Same request, five heights. Read them down the ladder and students hear the change immediately — no explanation needed. Then give them a situation and ask which rung it deserves.
practice.note_zh: 同一個要求，五種高度。從上往下唸一遍，學生立刻聽得出差別，不必解釋。然後給一個情境，問他們該用哪一階。
items: ① Give me a refund.　　　　← 命令，幾乎沒有人這樣說
② I want a refund.　　　　← 很直
③ Can I get a refund?　　　← 一般
④ Could I get a refund, please?　← 客氣
⑤ I was wondering if I could get a refund.　← 很客氣，用在對方可能會拒絕的時候
Which rung: 便利商店找錯零錢？飯店把你的訂房弄丟了？

practice.title_en: The trap · 'please' does not rescue a blunt sentence
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・加 please 救不了一句直白的話
practice.note_en: Students learn that 請 makes things polite and assume please does the same job. It does not — please softens an already-polite structure. Rebuild the sentence first, then add please if you like.
practice.note_zh: 學生學到「請」能讓話變客氣，就以為 please 也一樣。不是的——please 是替「本來就客氣的句型」加分。先把句子重蓋，之後要不要加 please 隨你。
items: ✗ Please give me a refund.　→　✓ Could I get a refund, please?
✗ Please repeat.　→　✓ Sorry, could you say that again?
✗ Please help me.　→　✓ Excuse me, could you help me for a second?
Your turn — rebuild: ✗ Please change my room.

practice.title_zh: 客服大挑戰・四個案件
practice.note_en: Dom's challenge, written as cases. Pairs take one each: one is the customer, one is the staff. The staff member must apologize, offer a solution, and the customer must accept or push politely. Swap roles and run again.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的挑戰，寫成案件。兩人一組各拿一件：一個當客人、一個當店員。店員要道歉並提出解法，客人要客氣地接受或再爭取。角色互換再跑一次。
items: Case 1　Your luggage did not arrive in New York.
Case 2　The phone you bought last week is already broken.
Case 3　The delivery came three days late and one item is missing.
Case 4　You ordered vegetarian noodles and there is pork in them.
Staff must use: I'm so sorry about that. · Let me see what I can do. · Could I offer you ______ ?

practice.title_zh: 出場券・往上爬一階
practice.note_en: Take a blunt sentence and rebuild it twice — once polite, once very polite.
practice.note_zh: 拿一句直白的話，重蓋兩次——一次客氣，一次非常客氣。
items: Blunt: Change my seat.
Polite: ______
Very polite: ______

21.vocab_label_zh: 整合複習 · 10 句救命句
21.prep_en: No preparation needed. This is the review week, so the list below is not vocabulary — it is the ten sentences that carry a person through a whole day in a foreign country. If a student leaves with only these, the unit has done its job.
21.prep_zh: 不必備課。這是複習週，所以下面這張表不是單字，是「能撐著一個人在異國過完一整天」的十句話。學生只帶走這十句，這個單元就算成功了。

words.en: Excuse me, could you tell me…?
words.example: Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is?
words.more: 第 16 週 · 裡面那半不倒裝

words.example: How much is this one?
words.more: 第 17 週

words.en: Do you have this in a different size?
words.more: 第 17 週

words.example: I'll have the beef noodles, please.
words.more: 第 18 週 · 不要用 I want

words.example: I'm allergic to peanuts.
words.more: 第 18 週 · 可能救命的一句
第 18、20 週 · 在任何地方都好用

words.example: Actually, I prefer somewhere quieter.
words.more: 第 19 週 · prefer A to B
第 19 週 · 最省力的正面回應

words.example: There's a problem with my reservation.
words.more: 第 20 週

words.en: Could I get a refund, please?
words.more: 第 20 週 · 禮貌階梯第四階

practice.title_en: The Big Taiwan Day · the planner
practice.title_zh: 台灣一日遊・行程表
practice.note_en: Dom's activity and her homework are the same shape, so fill this in during class and the homework is already half done. Every row needs a time, a price and one sentence a visitor could actually follow.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動和作業是同一個形狀，所以課堂上填完這張表，作業就先做掉一半。每一列都要有時間、價錢，和一句訪客真的跟得上的說明。
items: 09:00　Breakfast at ______ . Try ______ . About NT$______ .
10:30　Take the ______ to ______ . It takes about ______ minutes.
12:30　Lunch: ______ . Warn your visitor about ______ .
15:00　Afternoon: ______ . Entry is NT$______ .
18:00　Night market: ______ . Three things to eat: ______ .
21:00　Getting home: ______ .

practice.title_zh: 推薦的說法
practice.note_en: An itinerary without recommendation language is a timetable. Dom's homework asks for three recommendations — these are the structures that turn a list into advice.
practice.note_zh: 沒有推薦語的行程表只是時刻表。Dom 的作業要三個推薦——下面這些句型能把清單變成建議。
items: You should definitely try ______ .
If you only have time for one thing, go to ______ .
It's worth ______ -ing.　(It's worth waiting in line.)
I'd avoid ______ on weekends — it gets very crowded.
Make sure you ______ before you leave.

practice.title_zh: 生存快問・一人三十秒
practice.note_en: Call a situation; the student has thirty seconds to say the right sentence. No writing. This is the exam the whole unit was for, and it should feel fast and a little frightening.
practice.note_zh: 喊出情境，學生三十秒內說出正確的句子。不准寫。這是整個單元真正的考試，節奏要快，有一點緊張感才對。
items: You are lost at Taipei Main Station.
The shirt is too small.
You cannot eat seafood.
Your room key does not work.
The server brought the wrong dish.
Someone recommends a place — respond warmly.
You want to know what is good on the menu.
Your flight is delayed and you will miss your connection.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one day, one sentence
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一天，一句話
practice.note_en: The single recommendation they would give a visitor who has only one afternoon in Changhua. It has to be specific — a name, not a category.
practice.note_zh: 如果訪客在彰化只有一個下午，他們會給的那一個推薦。必須具體——要說得出名字，不能只說類別。
items: If you only have one afternoon in Changhua, you should ______ because ______ .

22.prep_en: No preparation needed. The story dice are written out below — copy the four lists onto the board, or cut them up and put them in four cups. The one thing to fix this week is 'and then', which will otherwise appear eleven times in every story.
22.prep_zh: 不必備課。故事骰的內容已經寫在下面——把四張清單抄上白板，或剪開放進四個杯子。這週唯一要修的是 and then，否則每篇故事都會出現十一次。

words.example: The setting is a night market in winter.
words.more: 故事的「哪裡」和「什麼時候」

words.example: The main character is a nine-year-old girl.
words.more: 注意：character 也指「性格」

words.example: The conflict starts when the money disappears.
words.more: 故事的引擎 · 沒有衝突就沒有故事

words.example: Her problem is that nobody believes her.
words.more: 比 conflict 口語 · 低年級用這個字就好

words.example: The solution comes from the smallest character.
words.more: a solution TO a problem

words.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.
words.more: 用來啟動衝突 · 一篇故事用一次就好

words.example: Finally, they found the missing envelope.
words.more: 收尾 · 不是 at last 的同義詞（at last 帶如釋重負）

words.example: Meanwhile, her brother was still asleep.
words.more: 切換到另一條線 · 第 7 週學過

practice.title_zh: 故事骰・四個杯子
practice.note_en: Dom's dice need faces, so here they are. Each team draws one from each cup and must use all four. The constraint is the point — a story nobody chose is easier to start than a story you have to invent from nothing.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的骰子需要骰面，這裡備好了。每組從四個杯子各抽一張，四樣都要用上。限制本身就是重點——沒得挑的故事，反而比從零想像容易開始。
items: CHARACTER　a forgetful grandmother · a new transfer student · a stray dog · a night market vendor · a bus driver · a very serious cat
PLACE　a temple at midnight · a crowded train · an empty classroom · a rooftop · a kitchen on New Year's Eve · a bus stop in the rain
PROBLEM　something is missing · someone is lying · the door will not open · a promise was broken · nobody speaks the same language · the money is gone
ACTION　runs away · tells the truth · hides it · asks for help · gives it back · pretends nothing happened

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・十一個 and then
practice.note_en: Chinese strings a story with 然後 and nobody minds. English counts repetitions, and 'and then' five times in a row is the clearest sign of a beginner. Give them six replacements and ban the phrase for one draft.
practice.note_zh: 中文用「然後」串故事，沒有人會覺得奇怪。英文會數重複，連續五個 and then 是最明顯的初學者標記。給他們六個替代品，然後規定這一稿禁用。
items: 然後 → after that · a moment later · the next morning · without thinking · while she waited · by the time he arrived
✗ She opened the door and then she saw the box and then she opened it.
✓ She opened the door. Inside was a box. Without thinking, she opened it.
Rule for this draft: you may use 'and then' exactly once.

practice.title_en: The shape of a story · five beats
practice.title_zh: 故事的形狀・五個拍子
practice.note_en: Draw this as a line that climbs and drops. Dom's homework is a 150-word outline, so fill the five beats in class and the outline is done — one sentence per beat is enough.
practice.note_zh: 把它畫成一條上升再落下的線。Dom 的作業是 150 字大綱，課堂上把五個拍子填完，大綱就完成了——一個拍子一句話就夠。
items: ① Setting　Where and when? One sentence.
② Character　Who wants something? What do they want?
③ Problem　What gets in the way?
④ Worst moment　When does it look hopeless?
⑤ Ending　What changes? (Do not write a moral — let the story say it.)

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one sentence that starts a story
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句可以開頭的話
practice.note_en: The first line only. It must make someone want the second line — a name and a problem in the same sentence usually does it.
practice.note_zh: 只寫第一句。這句要讓人想看第二句——通常一個名字加一個問題放在同一句就成了。
items: First line: ______

23.prep_en: No preparation needed. Describing people is where Chinese-speaking students meet the article wall: Chinese has no a, an or the at all, and this week needs them in almost every sentence. 'He is a reliable friend' — the little word is the hard part, not the adjective.
23.prep_zh: 不必備課。描述人物是中文母語學生撞上冠詞高牆的地方：中文完全沒有 a、an、the，而這週幾乎每一句都需要它們。He is a reliable friend——難的是那個小字，不是形容詞。

words.example: She is a generous host — nobody leaves hungry.
words.more: 第 12 週學過 · ↔ selfish

words.example: My grandfather is stubborn about his morning walk.
words.more: stubborn about something · 中性偏負面

words.example: He is the most reliable person on the team.
words.more: rely (v.) → reliable · ↔ unreliable

words.example: She is a curious child who takes things apart.
words.more: 第 1 週學過

words.example: He looked confident before the speech.
words.more: 第 1 週學過 · ↔ nervous

words.example: I get nervous when I have to read aloud.
words.more: nervous about something

words.example: It was thoughtful of her to bring an extra umbrella.
words.more: 兩個意思：體貼、以及若有所思

words.example: He has a mischievous smile.
words.more: 唸法：MIS-chi-vous（三音節，不是四個）· 調皮但不壞

practice.title_en: The trap · the little words Chinese does not have
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文沒有的那些小字
practice.note_en: Chinese has no articles, so students either drop them or sprinkle them randomly. Three rules cover almost everything this week needs. Put them on the board and point at them every time someone slips.
practice.note_zh: 中文沒有冠詞，所以學生不是漏掉就是亂灑。三條規則幾乎涵蓋這週會用到的全部。寫上白板，每次有人出錯就指一下。
items: ① 單數可數名詞前面一定要有東西：a / an / the / my / this
✗ He is reliable person.　✓ He is a reliable person.
② 第一次提到用 a，再提到用 the：I met a boy. The boy was crying.
③ 形容詞單獨當述語，不要加 a：✓ He is reliable.　✗ He is a reliable.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ She is very generous person and everyone likes her.

practice.title_en: Show, do not tell · give the evidence
practice.title_zh: 用行為代替形容詞
practice.note_en: Dom's CEFR line asks B1 students for evidence, and this is the exercise that gets it. Give the adjective, students supply a one-sentence action that proves it — without using the adjective itself.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的 CEFR 欄要求 B1 學生給出證據，這個練習就是在要證據。老師給形容詞，學生用一句行為證明它——而且不能用到那個形容詞。
items: stubborn → He has taken the same route to work for thirty years, even after they built the new road.
generous → ______
nervous → ______
mischievous → ______
reliable → ______
Rule: if the adjective appears in your sentence, it does not count.

practice.title_zh: 角色選角・資料卡
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Each team invents one character and fills this card, then 'casts' them — which actor, and why. The why is where the adjectives have to work.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。每組發明一個角色填完這張卡，然後替他選角——找哪個演員演、為什麼。「為什麼」才是形容詞真正要出力的地方。
items: Name and age: ______
Three personality adjectives: ______ , ______ , ______
One thing they always do: ______
One thing they would never do: ______
What they want most: ______
Cast: ______ , because ______

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one person, two sentences
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個人，兩句話
practice.note_en: One adjective, one piece of evidence. Articles must be correct — that is what is being checked.
practice.note_zh: 一個形容詞，一個證據。冠詞要對——這才是真正在檢查的東西。
items: ______ is a very ______ person.
I know this because ______ .

24.prep_en: No preparation needed. Two Chinese habits collide with this week: 有 becomes 'have' instead of 'there is', and 在 becomes whichever of in/on/at the student guesses first. Both show up in the very first sentence of every place description, so fix them early.
24.prep_zh: 不必備課。這週會同時撞上兩個中文習慣：「有」被翻成 have 而不是 there is，「在」則是 in／on／at 亂猜。每一篇地方描述的第一句就會出現這兩個錯，所以早點修。

words.example: The night market is crowded on Saturday nights.
words.more: 形容地方 · 人多用 crowded，不用 many people 當形容詞

words.example: The temple courtyard is peaceful in the morning.
words.more: peace (n.) → peaceful

words.example: Lukang has many narrow old streets.
words.more: ↔ wide · 不是 thin（thin 用在人或物）

words.example: The new library is bright and spacious.
words.more: space (n.) → spacious · 正面的「大」

words.example: An ancient banyan tree stands by the gate.
words.more: 第 12 週學過 · ↔ modern

words.example: The station is modern and very clean.
words.more: 第 12 週學過

words.example: Our classroom gets noisy after lunch.
words.more: noise (n.) → noisy · ↔ quiet

words.example: The view from Hehuanshan is breathtaking.
words.more: 極端字 · 不加 very · 第 13 週的規則

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・「有」不是 have
practice.note_en: This is the single most recognizable Taiwanese English error, and it comes straight from 有. A place does not 'have' things; there ARE things in it. Once a student hears the difference they rarely go back.
practice.note_zh: 這是最好認的台灣英語錯誤，直接來自「有」。地方不是 have 東西，而是「那裡有」= there is / there are。學生一旦聽出差別，很少再錯回去。
items: 夜市有很多人。 ✗ The night market has many people. ✓ There are many people in the night market.
我房間有一張書桌。 ✗ My room has a desk. ✓ There is a desk in my room.
（have 用在「人擁有」）✓ I have a desk. ✓ She has two brothers.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Our school has a big library and has many trees.

practice.title_en: in, on, at · where Chinese uses one word
practice.title_zh: in、on、at・中文只用一個「在」
practice.note_en: Three English words, one Chinese word, and no logic that transfers. Teach it as sizes: at is a point, on is a surface or a line, in is inside something. The exceptions are learned by ear, not by rule.
practice.note_zh: 英文三個字、中文一個「在」，而且沒有可以搬過來的邏輯。當成大小來教：at 是一個點，on 是面或線，in 是裡面。例外靠耳朵記，不靠規則。
items: at → at the bus stop · at school · at the corner　(一個點)
on → on the table · on the third floor · on Zhongshan Road　(面或線)
in → in the classroom · in Changhua · in my bag　(裡面)
注意：in the bus 還是 on the bus？→ on the bus（交通工具用 on）
Your turn: The night market is ______ Minzu Road, ______ Beidou.

practice.title_en: Mystery Place · with all five senses
practice.title_zh: 神秘地點・五感俱全
practice.note_en: Dom's guessing game, and her homework asks for all five senses. Most students write only what they see, so require one line per sense before anyone is allowed to guess.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的猜謎遊戲，她的作業要求五感俱全。多數學生只寫看到的，所以規定每一種感官都要寫一句，才能開放猜。
items: Smell: ______  ← 這一句通常最有辨識度
Taste or touch: ______
Feel (the mood): ______

Worked example (do not name it): It is narrow and crowded. You hear oil hissing and someone shouting prices. It smells of garlic and something sweet. The ground is slightly wet. You are hungry before you decide anything.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one room, three senses
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個房間，三種感官
practice.note_en: Three sentences about a room in their own home. One must start with 'There is' or 'There are'.
practice.note_zh: 寫自己家裡某個房間的三句話，其中一句必須用 There is 或 There are 開頭。
items: I can hear ______ .
It smells like ______ .

25.prep_en: No preparation needed. Two things to fix: 說 covers said, asked, replied and told, so students use 'said' for everything — Dom's word list is the cure. And English punctuates quotations in a way Chinese does not, which is invisible until you show it side by side.
25.prep_zh: 不必備課。這週修兩件事：中文一個「說」涵蓋 said、asked、replied、told，所以學生什麼都用 said——Dom 的字表就是解藥。另外英文的引號標點和中文不同，不並排對照給學生看，他們看不見。

words.example: "I'm not ready," she said.
