words.more: say → said · 後面接話，不接人 · 第 14 週的規則

words.example: "Where were you?" he asked.
words.more: 問句後面用 asked，不要用 said

words.example: "I was at the temple," she replied.
words.more: 回應前一句話 · 比 answered 文一點

words.example: "Don't tell anyone," he whispered.
words.more: 音量小 · 常帶秘密感

words.example: "Watch out!" someone shouted.
words.more: 音量大 · 驚嘆號通常跟著來

words.example: "The door locks by itself," she explained.
words.more: 用在說明原因的句子後面

words.example: "That's a good idea," they agreed.
words.more: agree with someone · agree to a plan

words.example: "I'll pay you next century," he joked.
words.more: 讓讀者知道那句不是認真的

practice.title_en: The trap · English punctuates quotations differently
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・英文的引號標點跟中文不一樣
practice.note_en: Chinese puts the full stop outside 「」. American English puts it inside, and a comma replaces the full stop when a tag follows. Nobody teaches this, so almost every student writes it wrong for years. Show the two side by side once and it lands.
practice.note_zh: 中文的句號放在「」外面。美式英文放在裡面，而且後面接 said 之類的時候，句號要換成逗號。這件事沒有人教，所以學生錯很多年。並排給他們看一次就懂了。
items: 中文：他說：「我累了。」
✗ He said "I am tired".
✓ He said, "I am tired."　← said 後面逗號 · 句號在引號裡面
✓ "I am tired," he said.　← 前半結尾用逗號，不是句號
✓ "Are you tired?" she asked.　← 問號本來就是標點，不必再加逗號
Your turn — fix this: ✗ "I don't know". He replied.

practice.title_zh: 不要什麼都用 said
practice.note_en: One Chinese word, eight English ones. Read the line aloud and pick the verb that matches how it sounds — the verb is doing half the acting.
practice.note_zh: 中文一個字，英文八個。把台詞唸出來，挑一個跟語氣相符的動詞——動詞替你演掉一半的戲。
items: "Get down from there!" she ______ .
"I think the door is locked," he ______ .
"Is that your bag?" the driver ______ .
"Don't worry, I've done this before," she ______ .
"Fine. You win," he ______ .
Note: a new speaker always starts a new line.

practice.title_zh: 改編劇本・無聊的情境
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs a situation, so here is a deliberately dull one. Twelve lines, two characters, and by line four something must go wrong. Friendship or family — Dom asks that Valentine's week stay off romance.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要一個情境，這裡給一個故意很無聊的。十二行、兩個角色，第四行之前一定要出事。主題走友情或家人——Dom 指定情人節那週避開戀愛。
items: Situation: two students are waiting for a bus that is very late.
Line 1–3　Small talk. Nothing happens.
Line 4　Something goes wrong.
Line 5–10　They disagree about what to do.
Line 11–12　One of them changes their mind.
Rule: use at least four different reporting verbs, and never 'said' twice in a row.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · two lines, punctuated correctly
practice.title_zh: 出場券・兩行對白，標點要對
practice.note_en: One statement, one question, both with a reporting verb that is not 'said'. The punctuation is the grade.
practice.note_zh: 一句陳述、一句問句，兩句的動詞都不能是 said。評分看標點。

26.prep_en: No preparation needed, but read the trap card first. Chinese has nothing like the past perfect, and the usual mistake after teaching it is overuse. The rule that prevents both problems: you only need it when you tell events out of order.
26.prep_zh: 不必備課，但先看陷阱卡。中文沒有任何對應過去完成式的東西，而教完之後最常見的問題反而是濫用。一條規則同時解決兩邊：只有在「不照順序講」的時候才需要它。

words.example: When we arrived, the train had already left.
words.more: had + 第三態 · already 夾在中間

words.example: She had never seen snow before that trip.
words.more: never 本身是否定，不要再加 not

words.example: He had finished his homework before dinner started.
words.more: 有 before 時，過去完成式常可省略——順序已經清楚了

words.example: After she had left, we found her keys.
words.more: 同上 · 順序清楚時用過去簡單式也可以

words.example: By the time the police came, the thief had disappeared.
words.more: 這個說法幾乎一定要接過去完成式

words.example: She realized that she had forgotten her wallet.
words.more: realize → realized · 後面很常接過去完成式

words.example: He remembered that he had locked the door.
words.more: remember → remembered

practice.title_en: The trap · you only need it out of order
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・不照順序才需要它
practice.note_en: Chinese tells events in the order they happened and 了 says no more than 'done'. English can jump backwards mid-sentence, and the past perfect is the signal that it just did. Tell the story in order and past simple is enough — that is why the tense feels invisible until it is needed.
practice.note_zh: 中文照事情發生的順序講，「了」只說明「完成」。英文可以在句子中途往回跳，過去完成式就是「我剛剛往回跳了」的信號。照順序講的話，過去簡單式就夠了——這就是為什麼這個時態平常看不見，需要時才出現。
items: 照順序（不需要）：I finished my homework. Then I watched TV.　✓ 兩個都用過去簡單式
往回跳（需要）：I watched TV. I had already finished my homework.
最常見的句型：When I arrived, she had already left.　← 到的時候，她「更早之前」就走了
✗ 濫用：Yesterday I had gone to school and I had eaten lunch and I had come home.　← 照順序，全部用過去簡單式就好
Your turn — choose: By the time we got there, the shop ______ (closed / had closed).

practice.title_en: The Mystery Timeline · put it in order
practice.title_zh: 神秘時間軸・排出順序
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs events to scramble, so here are six. Teams order them, then explain each one using 'had' — the explaining is the exercise, not the ordering.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要可以打亂的事件，這裡給六個。各組先排順序，再用 had 說明每一件——說明才是練習，排序不是。
items: A　The red envelope was on the table at 6:00.
B　Grandmother went to the temple at 6:30.
C　At 7:00 the envelope was gone.
D　The cat was asleep under the table all evening.
E　Little brother came home at 6:45 with new candy.
F　At 8:00 everyone was looking for the envelope.
Now say it: By the time grandmother returned, ______ . When they started looking, little brother ______ .

practice.title_zh: 一段話裡三種時態
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks for all three in one 180-word mystery. Build the skeleton here: background in past continuous, events in past simple, and one jump backwards in past perfect.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要在一篇 180 字的懸疑故事裡用上三種。在這裡先把骨架搭好：背景用過去進行式，事件用過去簡單式，往回跳一次用過去完成式。
items: 背景（was/were + -ing）：It ______ and everyone ______ in the kitchen.
事件（過去簡單式）：Then the lights ______ .
往回跳（had + 第三態）：Nobody remembered that someone ______ the back door.
再回到事件：When the lights came back, ______ .

practice.title_zh: 出場券・往回跳一次
practice.note_en: One sentence with two times in it: something that happened, and something that had happened before it.
practice.note_zh: 一句話裡放兩個時間：發生的事，和在那之前就已經發生的事。
items: When ______ , ______ had already ______ .

27.vocab_label_zh: 敘事工具箱 · 10 個說故事的零件
27.prep_en: No preparation needed. This is the writing week, so the list below is not new vocabulary — it is the toolkit from the last five weeks, gathered in one place. Dom asks students to choose eight power words of their own; this is where they choose from.
27.prep_zh: 不必備課。這是寫作週，所以下面不是新單字，是前五週工具的集合。Dom 要學生自選八個 power words，這就是他們挑選的地方。

words.example: Start with all three in your first two sentences.
words.more: 第 22 週 · 故事的三根柱子

words.example: A moment later, the door opened.
words.more: 第 22 週 · 拿來換掉 and then

words.example: Give evidence, not just the adjective.
words.more: 第 23 週 · 用行為證明

words.zh: 擁擠・寧靜・令人屏息
words.example: The alley was narrow and strangely peaceful.
words.more: 第 24 週 · 五感都要寫到

words.example: There was a light under the door.
words.more: 第 24 週 · 不是 have

words.zh: 低聲說・大喊・開玩笑說
words.example: "Don't move," she whispered.
words.more: 第 25 週 · 不要整篇都 said

words.example: The bus had already left.
words.more: 第 26 週 · 只有往回跳才用

words.example: By the time she looked up, he was gone.
words.more: 第 26 週 · 幾乎一定接過去完成式

words.example: Suddenly the music stopped.
words.more: 整篇只准用一次

words.example: Finally, she understood why.
words.more: 收尾用 · 不要寫出道理，讓故事自己說

practice.title_en: Story planner · fill this before you write
practice.title_zh: 故事規劃表・先填再寫
practice.note_en: Ten minutes on this saves thirty minutes of staring at a blank page. Every line is one sentence. If a student cannot fill line three, they do not have a story yet — they have a situation.
practice.note_zh: 花十分鐘填這張表，可以省下三十分鐘盯著空白頁。每一行寫一句。第三行填不出來的學生，手上還沒有故事，只有一個情境。
items: Who is this about, and what do they want? ______
Where and when? ______
What gets in the way? ______
What is the worst moment? ______
What is different at the end? ______
My eight power words: ______

practice.title_zh: 修稿檢查表・整個單元
practice.note_en: Hand this out with the first draft, not before. Every line is something the class has already learned, so the checklist is a review disguised as editing.
practice.note_zh: 這張表要在第一稿寫完之後才發，不要提前。每一行都是全班學過的東西，所以這張檢查表是偽裝成修稿的複習。
items: □ 'and then' 出現幾次？超過一次就改掉。（W22）
□ 每個單數可數名詞前面有沒有 a / an / the？（W23）
□ 有沒有寫成 The place has…？改成 There is / There are。（W24）
□ 對白的句號在引號裡面嗎？said 有沒有連用兩次？（W25）
□ 有沒有一次往回跳？沒有的話，加一句 had already。（W26）
□ 最後一句有沒有寫出道理？有的話刪掉。

practice.title_zh: 六十秒口述
practice.note_en: Dom asks for a spoken summary as well as the written story. Sixty seconds is about 130 words, which is four sentences — this shape fits every time.
practice.note_zh: Dom 除了書面故事還要一段口述。六十秒大約 130 字，也就是四句話——這個形狀每次都套得上。
items: ① This is a story about ______ , who wants ______ .
② The problem is ______ .
③ The worst moment is when ______ .
④ In the end, ______ . (不要爆雷結局，停在這裡也可以)
Practise it twice with a partner before the premiere.

practice.title_zh: 故事首映會・獎項
practice.note_en: Dom asks classmates to award fun categories, so here are eight. Every story must win exactly one — decide that in advance and nobody sits down empty-handed.
practice.note_zh: Dom 要同學頒些有趣的獎項，這裡給八個。規定每篇故事都必須得到一個獎——事先講明，就不會有人空手坐下。
items: Best First Line · Most Surprising Ending · Best Villain
Best Use of Silence · Funniest Line of Dialogue
Most Vivid Place · Character We Would Most Like to Meet
Best Sentence in the Whole Class （唸出來給大家聽）

28.prep_en: No preparation needed. Chinese marks the future with a time word and leaves the verb alone — 明天我去台北. English has three different futures and choosing between them is the whole week. Teach the choice as a question about when the decision was made.
28.prep_zh: 不必備課。中文用時間詞標記未來，動詞不動——「明天我去台北」。英文有三種未來式，這週的全部就是怎麼選。把選擇教成一個問題：這個決定是什麼時候做的？

words.example: We are planning to visit Kenting in July.
words.more: 已經決定好的 → be going to / 現在進行式

words.example: I predict that our team will win.
words.more: prediction (n.) · 預測用 will

words.example: I promise I will call you tonight.
words.more: 承諾一定用 will，不用 going to

words.example: It will probably rain this afternoon.
words.more: 放在 will 後面：will probably

words.example: I am definitely going to finish it tonight.
words.more: 拼字注意：definite，沒有 a

words.example: I am meeting my cousin tomorrow.
words.more: 已排定的約 → 用現在進行式，不用 will

words.example: We are moving house next month.
words.more: next week / next month · 前面不加 the

words.example: I'll do it later, I promise.
words.more: 當下決定 → will

practice.title_en: The trap · one Chinese future, three English ones
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文一種未來，英文三種
practice.note_en: Chinese says 明天我去台北 and the listener works out the rest. English asks you to declare when you decided. Teach it as a timeline of the decision, not of the event.
practice.note_zh: 中文說「明天我去台北」，其餘靠聽的人自己判斷。英文要求你交代「什麼時候決定的」。把它教成「決定的時間軸」，不是「事件的時間軸」。
items: 現在才決定 → will：The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
早就決定了 → be going to：I'm going to study medicine.
已經約好了 → 現在進行式：I'm meeting the dentist at four.
✗ Tomorrow I go to Taipei.　✓ I'm going to Taipei tomorrow.
Your turn — choose: A: There's no milk. B: Oh, ______ (I'll buy / I'm going to buy) some.

practice.title_zh: 未來預報・預測同學的未來
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Each student draws a classmate's name and writes three predictions with will. Kind predictions only — the rule keeps it funny instead of sharp.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。每個學生抽一位同學的名字，用 will 寫三個預測。只准寫善意的預測——這條規則讓它保持好笑，不會變刻薄。
items: In ten years, ______ will probably ______ .
______ will definitely never ______ .
I think ______ will be the first person in our class to ______ .
Then: turn the three best into a ridiculous 2030 news report and read it aloud.

practice.title_zh: 計畫、預測、承諾・分類
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks for three of each, so sort before writing. Read each sentence and decide which of the three it is — the form follows once the category is clear.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業三種各要三句，所以先分類再寫。唸出句子，判斷它屬於哪一種——類別清楚了，形式自己就出來了。
items: I'm going to join the basketball team next semester. → ?
Don't worry, I'll help you tomorrow. → ?
Taiwan will win more Olympic medals in 2032. → ?
We're flying to Japan on the 15th. → ?
I think it's going to rain — look at those clouds. → ? (證據在眼前 → going to)

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · three futures, one day
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一天，三種未來
practice.note_en: Three sentences about tomorrow, one in each form. Same day, three different reasons for choosing.
practice.note_zh: 寫三句關於明天的話，三種形式各一句。同一天，三個不同的選擇理由。
items: Arrangement: I am ______ tomorrow.
Plan: I am going to ______ .
Promise or decision: I'll ______ .

29.prep_en: No preparation needed. Two mechanical rules save the whole week: a modal never takes -s, and a modal never takes 'to'. Then one meaning distinction that Chinese does not make at all — mustn't is forbidden, don't have to is optional. Students mix those two for years.
29.prep_zh: 不必備課。兩條機械規則就救掉整週：情態動詞後面不加 -s，也不加 to。然後是一個中文根本不區分的意思差別——mustn't 是禁止，don't have to 是不必。學生會混很多年。

words.example: She can swim very well.
words.more: 能力、許可 · ✗ She cans · ✗ can to swim

words.example: Could you help me for a second?
words.more: 過去的能力，或客氣的請求（第 20 週的禮貌階梯）

words.example: You should drink more water.
words.more: 建議 · 不是命令

words.example: You must wear a helmet. / She must be tired.
words.more: 兩個意思：義務、以及推論（一定是）

words.example: I have to wear a uniform at school.
words.more: 唯一會變化的：he has to · 過去式 had to

words.example: It might rain later.
words.more: 機率低於 will · might 沒有過去式變化

words.example: May I come in?
words.more: 比 can 正式 · 考場、正式場合常見

words.example: We ought to leave now.
words.more: ≈ should 但更正式 · 唯一帶 to 的情態動詞

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・兩條機械規則
practice.note_en: Chinese verbs never change, so students add -s to modals by over-correcting, and add 'to' because every other verb pattern seems to want one. Neither is ever right (except ought to). Write both rules on the board and point at them.
practice.note_zh: 中文動詞從不變化，所以學生會因為「矯枉過正」給情態動詞加 -s，又因為其他動詞句型都要 to 而加了 to。兩者都不對（ought to 除外）。兩條規則寫上白板，出錯就指。
items: ① 不加 -s：✗ He cans swim. ✗ She musts go. ✓ He can swim. ✓ She must go.
② 不加 to：✗ I must to go. ✗ You should to rest. ✓ I must go. ✓ You should rest.
例外只有一個：ought to（本來就帶 to）
Your turn — fix this: ✗ My sister cans speak Japanese and she musts practice every day.

practice.title_zh: mustn't 還是 don't have to？
practice.note_en: Chinese does not separate these clearly, and the two English meanings are opposites. One forbids, one releases. Get this wrong on a school rule and the sentence says the opposite of what you meant.
practice.note_zh: 中文不太分這兩個，但英文的兩個意思是相反的：一個是禁止，一個是解除。學校規定寫錯這個，整句意思就反了。
items: You mustn't use your phone in class. = 禁止（不可以）
You don't have to bring lunch on Friday. = 不必（可以，但不需要）
Your turn — choose: You ______ be late for the exam.
Your turn — choose: You ______ wear a uniform on Sports Day. (那天可以穿便服)

practice.title_zh: 煩惱諮詢專線・來電者
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs problems, so here are six callers. Teams answer as the hotline and must use a different modal each time. Points for the most natural answer, not the most grammatical.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要問題，這裡備了六位來電者。各組扮演專線回答，每次要用不同的情態動詞。最自然的答案得分，不是最文法正確的。
items: "My cat sleeps on my homework and I can't move her."
"I forgot my best friend's birthday. Yesterday."
"My little brother copies everything I say."
"I have a test tomorrow and I haven't started."
"I told my teacher I was sick, but she saw me at the night market."
"My neighbour's rooster wakes me at 4 a.m. every day."

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one rule, one piece of advice
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一條規定，一個建議
practice.note_en: Dom's homework is a Student Survival Guide. Write the first two lines here — one thing that is forbidden, one thing that is merely a good idea.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業是學生生存指南。在這裡先寫兩行——一件被禁止的事，一件只是建議的事。
items: At our school you mustn't ______ .
But you should ______ .

30.prep_en: No preparation needed. Chinese compares with 比 and adds 更 for emphasis — 更高. Students translate both halves and produce 'more taller'. One rule stops it: English marks the comparison once, either with -er or with more, never both.
30.prep_zh: 不必備課。中文用「比」比較，再用「更」加強——「更高」。學生兩半都翻，就寫出 more taller。一條規則就擋住：英文只標記一次，要嘛 -er 要嘛 more，不能兩個都來。

words.example: Taichung is bigger than Changhua.
words.more: 短字加 -er · big → bigger（雙寫 g）

words.example: This book is more interesting than the film.
words.more: 長字（三音節以上）用 more · ✗ interestinger

words.example: Night market food is less expensive than restaurant food.
words.more: less = 反方向的 more · 也可以說 cheaper

words.example: Her English is better than mine.
words.more: 不規則！good → better → the best · ✗ gooder

words.example: The traffic is worse on Fridays.
words.more: 不規則！bad → worse → the worst · ✗ badder

words.example: That is the best beef noodle soup in Changhua.
words.more: 最高級前面一定要 the

words.example: It was the most exciting game of the season.
words.more: 長字的最高級 · the most + 形容詞

practice.title_en: The trap · mark it once, not twice
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・只標記一次
practice.note_en: 「更高」has two pieces and English has one. Translating both gives 'more taller', which is the single most common comparative error in Taiwan. Say the rule out loud: -er OR more, never both.
practice.note_zh: 「更高」有兩個零件，英文只有一個。兩個都翻就變成 more taller——這是台灣最常見的比較級錯誤。把規則唸出來：-er 或 more，不能兩個都要。
items: ✗ more taller　✗ more bigger　✗ most easiest
✓ taller　✓ bigger　✓ the easiest
短字（1–2 音節）→ -er / -est：tall, big, easy, happy
長字（3 音節以上）→ more / the most：interesting, expensive, beautiful
Your turn — fix this: ✗ This test was more easier than the last one.

practice.title_en: than, as … as, and 越來越
practice.title_zh: than、as…as，以及「越來越」
practice.note_en: Three patterns, and the third one has no obvious English shape at all. 越來越 becomes a doubled comparative, which students never guess on their own.
practice.note_zh: 三個句型，第三個在英文裡根本沒有明顯的對應形狀。「越來越」要變成重複的比較級，學生自己絕對猜不到。
items: A 比 B → A is ______er than B.　(✗ than I ✓ than me，口語)
A 跟 B 一樣 → A is as tall as B.　(中間放原形，不是比較級)
越來越熱 → It's getting hotter and hotter.
越來越有趣 → It's getting more and more interesting.
Your turn: 天氣越來越冷。→ ______

practice.title_zh: 台灣對美國・尊重地比較
practice.note_en: Dom's challenge, with her word 'respectfully' taken seriously. Comparison is not ranking. Require every pair to include one thing each side does better — that rule alone raises the quality of the English.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的挑戰，而且認真看待她寫的「尊重地」。比較不是排名。規定每一組都要寫出雙方各自更好的一件事——光這條規則就會把英文的品質拉高。
items: Transportation: ______
School life: ______
Weather: ______
Rule: no sentence may say one country is simply 'better'.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · two things you know well
practice.title_zh: 出場券・兩個你很熟的東西
practice.note_en: Two comparisons about things the student actually knows — one short adjective, one long one. Both marked once.
practice.note_zh: 寫兩句學生真的熟悉的東西的比較——一個短形容詞、一個長形容詞。兩句都只能標記一次。

31.prep_en: No preparation needed, and there is one error to hunt all lesson: will after if. Chinese says 如果明天會下雨 with 會 sitting right there in the if-half, so students carry it across. English forbids it. If-half present, other half will — say it as a chant.
31.prep_zh: 不必備課，整堂課只獵一個錯：if 後面的 will。中文說「如果明天會下雨」，那個「會」就在 if 那半裡，學生會直接搬過去。英文不准。if 那半用現在式，另一半用 will——當口訣唸。

words.example: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.more: if 那一半不用 will · 這是整週的重點

words.example: We'll go unless it rains.
words.more: = if not · 後面不要再加 not

words.example: You can borrow it as long as you return it.
words.more: 條件式的另一種說法

words.example: Imagine you could fly anywhere.
words.more: 帶出第二條件句的好工具

words.example: If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.
words.more: 第二條件句的主句 · would + 原形

words.example: If I lived in Taipei, I could take the MRT every day.
words.more: 比 would 弱一點：有可能、辦得到

words.example: If we left now, we might catch the train.
words.more: 最不確定的那一個

practice.title_zh: 陷阱・if 後面不放 will
practice.note_en: The single most persistent conditional error among Chinese speakers, and it comes straight from 會 sitting inside the if-half. English puts the future meaning in only one half of the sentence. Chant it: if-half present, other half will.
practice.note_zh: 中文母語者最頑固的條件句錯誤，來源就是「會」待在 if 那半裡。英文只在其中一半放未來的意思。當口訣唸：if 那半現在式，另一半 will。
items: 如果明天會下雨，我就待在家。
✗ If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay home.
✓ If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ If you will come early, we will have more time.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I will call you if I will arrive late.

practice.title_zh: 三種條件句，三種距離
practice.note_en: Not three grammar rules — three degrees of how real it is. Chinese marks none of this, so give students the question to ask: is this always true, might it happen, or is it just imagination?
practice.note_zh: 這不是三條文法規則，是三種「有多真實」的程度。中文完全不標記，所以給學生一個可以問的問題：這是永遠成立、可能發生，還是純粹想像？
items: 永遠成立（零條件）→ If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
可能發生（第一條件）→ If I finish early, I will call you.
純粹想像（第二條件）→ If I were a bird, I would fly to Japan.
注意第二條件句往回退一格：had（不是 have）· were（不是 was）· would（不是 will）
Your turn — choose: If I ______ (am / were) the principal, I would cancel Monday.

practice.title_en: What Would You Do? · twelve scenarios
practice.title_zh: 你會怎麼做？・十二個情境
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Read one out; students must answer in a full second conditional, not just a phrase. The silly ones loosen the class and the serious ones are where the good English appears.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。唸出一個情境，學生要用完整的第二條件句回答，不能只講詞組。荒謬的題目讓氣氛鬆開，正經的題目才會長出好英文。
items: …you found a wallet with NT$10,000 in it?
…you could speak every language in the world?
…you woke up as your English teacher?
…you could change one rule at this school?
…you had to live in another country for a year?
…your phone disappeared for a month?
…you could have dinner with anyone in history?
…you saw your friend cheating on a test?

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one real, one imaginary
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句真實，一句想像
practice.note_en: Two sentences. The first must be something that could genuinely happen this week; the second must be impossible.
practice.note_zh: 兩句話。第一句要是這禮拜真的可能發生的事，第二句要是不可能的事。

32.prep_en: No preparation needed, but know this before you teach: 被 in Chinese usually means something bad happened to you — 被騙, 被罵. English passive carries no such feeling. It is neutral, and it is everywhere in signs, science and news. Students avoid it because it feels like complaining.
32.prep_zh: 不必備課，但教之前要知道一件事：中文的「被」通常代表倒楣事——被騙、被罵。英文的被動語態沒有這種感覺，它是中性的，而且在告示、科學、新聞裡到處都是。學生會避開它，因為那感覺像在抱怨。

words.example: This bowl was made in Yingge.
words.more: be + 第三態 · 第 9 週的三態在這裡派上用場

words.example: The bubble tea was invented in Taichung.
words.more: invent → invented · invention (n.)

words.example: This temple was built over 200 years ago.
words.more: build → built → built

words.example: The hot spring was discovered by accident.
words.more: discover → discovered（第 1 週的字）

words.example: Most of Taiwan's oysters are produced along this coast.
words.more: are produced（現在被動）· production (n.)

words.example: The logo was designed by a student.
words.more: by + 人：真的需要講是誰的時候才加

practice.title_en: The trap · English passive is not 被
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・英文的被動不等於「被」
practice.note_en: Chinese 被 carries bad news, so students feel the passive is negative and avoid it. But almost every sign, label and science sentence in English is passive, and none of them is complaining. Show neutral examples until the feeling wears off.
practice.note_zh: 中文的「被」帶著壞消息，所以學生覺得被動語態是負面的，能避就避。但英文的告示、標籤、科學句子幾乎都是被動，沒有一句在抱怨。多看幾個中性的例子，那種感覺就會退掉。
items: 中文的「被」：他被騙了。他被罵了。　← 都是壞事
英文的被動（完全中性）：Bubble tea was invented in Taichung.
English is spoken here. · The museum was built in 1908. · Breakfast is served until ten.
中文表達這些時不用「被」：珍珠奶茶「是在台中發明的」
So: 不要問「這句有沒有被」，要問「重點是動作還是做的人」。

practice.title_zh: 什麼時候要反過來寫
practice.note_en: The passive is a choice about what goes first. Put the important thing at the front of the sentence. Four situations cover nearly every real use.
practice.note_zh: 被動語態是在選擇「什麼先出場」。把重要的東西放句首。四種情況涵蓋幾乎所有真實用法。
items: ① 不知道是誰做的：My bicycle was stolen last night.
② 誰做的不重要：The road is being repaired.
③ 大家都知道是誰做的：He was arrested yesterday.（警察，不必說）
④ 重點是東西本身：This temple was built in 1738.
Your turn — which reason? "English is taught in every school in Taiwan."

practice.title_en: Mystery Object · how was it made?
practice.title_zh: 神秘物件・它是怎麼來的？
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Hold up an everyday object; teams guess its story entirely in the passive. Wrong answers are fine — the sentences are the point, not the facts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。舉起一個日常物品，各組全部用被動語態猜它的來歷。猜錯沒關係——重點是句子，不是事實。
items: Objects: a plastic straw · a pencil · a school uniform · a rice cooker · a face mask · a baseball
Frame: It is made of ______ . It was probably made in ______ .
It was invented about ______ years ago. It is used for ______ .
Bonus: Was it designed by one person or by a company?

practice.title_zh: 出場券・把它翻過來
practice.note_en: One active sentence rewritten as passive, plus the reason for the change. The reason is the harder half.
practice.note_zh: 把一句主動句改寫成被動，並說明為什麼要改。說明理由才是難的那一半。
items: Active: Someone broke the window last night.
Passive: ______
Why passive? ______

33.prep_en: No preparation needed, but this is the week with the biggest structural flip of the year. Chinese puts the description BEFORE the noun — 穿紅衣服的女孩. English puts it AFTER — the girl who is wearing red. Everything else this week is detail; that flip is the lesson.
33.prep_zh: 不必備課，但這是整年結構翻轉最大的一週。中文把描述放在名詞「前面」——穿紅衣服的女孩。英文放在「後面」——the girl who is wearing red。這週其餘都是細節，那個翻轉才是課。

words.example: The teacher who taught me English moved to Taipei.
words.more: 人 · 也可以用 that

words.example: The bus which goes to Lukang leaves at nine.
words.more: 事物 · 也可以用 that

words.example: This is the restaurant that my father likes.
words.more: 最通用 · 口語中最常出現

words.example: That is the park where we met.
words.more: 地點 · 後面接完整句子

words.example: The student whose bag was lost is waiting outside.
words.more: 誰的 · who's（who is）不一樣，別混

words.example: She is the person who organized everything.
words.more: 複數用 people

words.example: Beidou is the place where I grew up.
words.more: place + where

words.example: The thing that surprised me was the price.
words.more: thing + that

words.example: That is the reason why I was late.
words.more: reason + why

practice.title_en: The trap · English describes from behind
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・英文從後面描述
practice.note_en: This is the biggest word-order difference of the whole year. Chinese loads the description in front of the noun and ends with 的. English names the thing first, then adds the description behind it. Draw an arrow on the board pointing backwards in Chinese and forwards in English.
practice.note_zh: 這是整年最大的語序差異。中文把描述堆在名詞前面，用「的」收尾；英文先講那個東西，再把描述接在後面。在白板上畫兩支箭：中文往前指，英文往後指。
items: 穿紅衣服的女孩　→　描述在前，名詞在後
✗ the wearing red clothes girl
✓ the girl who is wearing red　→　名詞在前，描述在後
昨天我遇到的那個男生 → ✓ the boy that I met yesterday
Your turn: 那家我媽很喜歡的麵店 → ______

practice.title_en: The second trap · do not say it twice
practice.title_zh: 第二個陷阱・不要講兩次
practice.note_en: Chinese repeats the noun inside the description — 我昨天遇到他的那個男生. English uses the relative pronoun instead of the second mention, so the pronoun must go. This one survives for years unless it is named.
practice.note_zh: 中文會在描述裡把那個人再講一次——「我昨天遇到『他』的那個男生」。英文用關係代名詞取代第二次出現，所以那個代名詞必須刪掉。不特別點出來，這個錯會跟著學生很多年。
items: ✗ The boy who I met him yesterday is my cousin.
✓ The boy who I met yesterday is my cousin.
✗ The book which I bought it last week is missing.
✓ The book which I bought last week is missing.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ The restaurant that we ate there was very cheap.

practice.title_zh: 句子手術・接起來
practice.note_en: Dom's activity. Two short sentences go in, one stronger sentence comes out. Do the first together, then let teams race. Her homework asks for twelve pairs, so this is the rehearsal.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動。兩個短句進去，一個更有力的句子出來。第一題一起做，之後各組競賽。她的作業要十二組，這裡是彩排。
items: I have a friend. She lives in Kaohsiung. → I have a friend who lives in Kaohsiung.
This is the temple. My grandmother goes there every morning. → ______
I lost the umbrella. My father gave it to me. → ______
That is the student. Her painting won the prize. → ______
We watched a film. It was three hours long. → ______
That is the reason. I could not come yesterday. → ______

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one person, one place
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個人，一個地方
practice.note_en: Two sentences, each with a relative clause, both about things the student actually knows. No repeated pronoun inside the clause.
practice.note_zh: 兩句話，各含一個關係子句，而且都要是學生真的知道的人事物。子句裡不可以出現重複的代名詞。
items: My favourite teacher is someone who ______ .
______ is the place where ______ .

34.prep_en: No preparation needed, but read the trap card before this unit starts — it explains the whole media unit. Students with large vocabularies still cannot hear English, and the reason is rhythm, not words. Chinese gives every syllable the same length; English squashes the unstressed ones almost to nothing. Songs exaggerate this, which is why they teach listening better than any textbook.
34.prep_zh: 不必備課，但整個單元開始前先看陷阱卡——它解釋了這七週的全部。學生單字量夠大卻還是聽不懂英文，原因是節奏，不是字。中文每個音節長度差不多，英文把非重音的音節壓到幾乎不見。歌曲把這件事誇大了，所以它教聽力比任何課本都有效。

words.example: I looked up the lyrics after the first listen.
words.more: 永遠用複數 · ✗ a lyric（除非指一句）

words.example: Everyone sings along with the chorus.
words.more: 重複的那一段 · 先學副歌最有效率

words.example: The second verse tells you what happened.
words.more: 故事通常藏在 verse，不在 chorus

words.example: Clap on the beat while you listen.
words.more: 英文的重音會落在 beat 上——這就是聽得懂的鑰匙

words.example: What is the message of this song?
words.more: Dom 的作業要問這個

words.example: The song has a lonely feeling.
words.more: feeling 是感覺，emotion 較正式

words.example: "Let it go" is a useful phrase.
words.more: 唸法：/freɪz/ · 一組字，不是一個字

words.example: That expression means you should stop worrying.
words.more: 兩個意思：語言的說法、臉上的表情

practice.title_en: The trap · you cannot hear it because it is not there
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・聽不到是因為它真的不見了
practice.note_en: This is the most important card in the unit. Chinese is syllable-timed — 你在做什麼 gives five syllables five beats. English is stress-timed: content words keep their length, everything else gets crushed. Students are not missing vocabulary; they are listening for sounds that were never pronounced.
practice.note_zh: 這是整個單元最重要的一張卡。中文是音節等長——「你在做什麼」五個字五拍。英文是重音等距：實詞保留長度，其餘全部被壓扁。學生缺的不是單字，他們是在聽一些根本沒有被唸出來的聲音。
items: What are you doing? → 唸起來像 "Whatcha doin'?"
I would have gone. → 像 "I'd-uv gone."　(would have 幾乎消失)
Do you want to go? → "D'ya wanna go?"
重音落在：名詞、主要動詞、形容詞、疑問詞
被壓扁的是：a, the, of, to, have, are, was, and
課堂實驗：拍手唸 "CATS eat FISH" 和 "the CATS have EAten the FISH"——拍子一樣多，字數不一樣。

practice.title_zh: 聽三次，三種任務
practice.note_en: One listen with three different instructions beats three aimless listens. Never ask students to understand everything on the first pass — that is what makes them give up.
practice.note_zh: 同一首歌聽三次、每次任務不同，勝過漫無目的聽三次。絕對不要在第一次就要求全部聽懂——那正是讓學生放棄的原因。
items: 第一次　只聽感覺：快樂？難過？生氣？不看歌詞。
第二次　只抓重複最多的那一句（通常就是 chorus）。
第三次　發歌詞，挖空八個字，補上去。
最後才討論：What is the message? 這一題要用英文回答。

practice.title_zh: 音樂頒獎典禮・獎項
practice.note_en: Dom's awards-show framing. Each team nominates one song and must defend it in English. The defence is the assessment — the award itself is just the excuse.
practice.note_zh: Dom 設計的頒獎典禮。每組提名一首歌，並用英語替它辯護。辯護才是評量，獎項只是藉口。
items: Best Message · 最值得聽的一句話
Best Vocabulary · 學到最多新字的一首
Easiest to Understand · 最聽得懂的一首（說出為什麼）
Hardest to Understand · 最難的一首（說出哪裡難）
Frame: We nominate ______ because ______ . The best line is " ______ ."

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one line you can now hear
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句你現在聽得懂的話
practice.note_en: One line from the song, written out, plus what it sounded like before they saw it written. The gap between the two is the lesson.
practice.note_zh: 寫下歌裡的一句話，再寫下「還沒看到歌詞之前聽起來像什麼」。兩者之間的差距就是這堂課。
items: The line: ______
What I thought I heard: ______

35.prep_en: No preparation needed. Last week explained why listening is hard; this week gives the strategy. Students raised on 每個字都要懂 try to catch every word and freeze at the first one they miss. Teach them to keep going — meaning arrives late, and it arrives anyway.
35.prep_zh: 不必備課。上週解釋了聽力為什麼難，這週給策略。從小被訓練「每個字都要懂」的學生會想抓住每一個字，漏掉一個就當機。要教他們繼續往前——意思會晚一點到，但它會到。

words.example: Before you press play, predict what happens next.
words.more: prediction (n.) · 第 28 週學過

words.example: Did you notice what he was holding?
words.more: 第 7 週學過

words.example: Explain why you think that.
words.more: explanation (n.)

words.example: What evidence do you have for that guess?
words.more: 不可數！✗ evidences ✓ a piece of evidence

words.example: He is probably her brother.
words.more: 約 80% 把握

words.example: Perhaps they have met before.
words.more: 約 50% · 比 probably 不確定

words.example: Actually, she was right the whole time.
words.more: 第 19 週提醒過：常帶「更正」的味道

words.example: Suddenly everyone stopped talking.
words.more: 第 7、22 週學過

practice.title_en: The trap · you do not need every word
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・不必聽懂每一個字
practice.note_en: Chinese schooling rewards catching every character; English listening punishes it. Missing a word and stopping to worry about it costs you the next ten. Native speakers miss words constantly and never notice. Say that out loud — it releases students more than any technique.
practice.note_zh: 中文的學習訓練獎勵「每個字都抓到」，英文聽力卻會處罰這個習慣。漏掉一個字就停下來擔心，代價是後面十個字。母語者也一直在漏字，只是沒發現。把這句話講出來——它比任何技巧都更能解放學生。
items: 目標不是 100%，是 70% 就繼續走。
漏掉一個字 → 不要回頭，往前聽，意思通常在下一句補回來。
先抓：誰、在哪、在做什麼、心情如何。細節之後再說。
課堂規則：這節課不准問 "What did he say?"，只能問 "What is happening?"

practice.title_en: Watch → Pause → Predict · the points system
practice.title_zh: 看→暫停→預測・計分方式
practice.note_en: Dom's activity, with scoring that rewards the right thing. A correct guess is worth one point; a guess backed by evidence from the video is worth three — even if it turns out wrong. That scoring changes what students pay attention to.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動，配上獎勵正確東西的計分。猜對得一分；能說出影片裡的證據得三分——就算猜錯也一樣。這個計分方式會改變學生注意的東西。
items: Pause 1（開頭 20 秒後）Who are these people? What is the relationship?
Pause 2 What is the problem going to be?
Pause 3（中段）What will he do next? Why do you think so?
Pause 4（結尾前）How does this end?
Scoring: 猜對 1 分 · 有證據 3 分 · 「我就是覺得」0 分
Frame: I think ______ because I noticed ______ .

practice.title_en: probably or perhaps? · how sure are you
practice.title_zh: probably 還是 perhaps？・你有多確定
practice.note_en: Prediction needs hedging language, and Chinese hedges with 應該吧 / 可能 without grading the probability much. English grades it finely, and getting the level right is what makes a guess sound intelligent.
practice.note_zh: 預測需要保留語氣，而中文的「應該吧」「可能」不太分程度。英文分得很細，用對程度，猜測才會聽起來聰明。
items: definitely 95% → certainly 90% → probably 80% → maybe / perhaps 50% → might 40%
He is definitely the father. ← 只有在證據很強時才這樣說
She is probably a teacher — look at the books.
Perhaps they are neighbours, but I am not sure.
Your turn: 用三種不同的確定程度，各說一句關於影片的預測。

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one guess with evidence
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個有證據的猜測
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks for two predictions. Write the first here, and it must contain the word 'because'.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要兩個預測，第一個在這裡寫。句子裡一定要有 because。
items: I think ______ because ______ .

36.prep_en: No preparation needed. Advertising English is built from three things students can spot in one lesson: imperatives, extreme adjectives, and the word 'you'. Once they can see the machinery, they can build it — and they also stop being fooled by it.
36.prep_zh: 不必備課。廣告英文由三樣東西組成，學生一堂課就能看出來：祈使句、極端形容詞，以及 you 這個字。看懂機器怎麼運作之後，他們既能自己造一台，也比較不會被它騙。

words.example: That advertisement was on three times tonight.
words.more: 口語縮寫 ad / advert · 唸法重音在 -VER-

words.example: Who is the audience for this product?
words.more: 廣告第一個問題永遠是這個

words.example: People trust the brand more than the product.
words.more: brand name · branding

words.example: This ad did not convince me.
words.more: convince someone to do something

words.example: Every ad makes a promise.
words.more: 第 28 週學過 · 廣告的承諾常常沒說完

words.example: List the benefits, not the features.
words.more: feature 是「功能」，benefit 是「對你的好處」——廣告賣後者

words.example: High quality, low price — the oldest promise there is.
words.more: 注意：quality 品質 · quantity 數量（第 17 週）

words.example: Limited time only!
words.more: 製造急迫感的字 · 通常不是真的

practice.title_zh: 廣告的機器・三個零件
practice.note_en: Take apart a real ad in five minutes with this list, then hand it back as a build kit. Students who can name the parts write far better commercials than students told to 'be persuasive'.
practice.note_zh: 用這張清單五分鐘拆掉一支真廣告，再把它當成組裝說明書發回去。說得出零件名稱的學生，寫出來的廣告遠勝過只被告知「要有說服力」的學生。
items: ① 祈使句（命令你動作）：Try it. Taste the difference. Don't wait.
② 極端形容詞：stunning · unbelievable · perfect · the only ______ you will ever need
③ 對著「你」說話：You deserve it. Your family will thank you.
加分零件：數字（9 out of 10）· 急迫（Limited time）· 問句（Tired of ______ ?）
Spot check: 從一支廣告裡找出這三樣，各舉一例。

practice.title_en: The trap · ads break the rules on purpose
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・廣告是故意違規的
practice.note_en: Students learn English from media and then copy advertising grammar into essays. Ad English is deliberately clipped and ungrammatical because it has three seconds. Name it explicitly, or a teacher will be correcting 'Think different' for months.
practice.note_zh: 學生從媒體學英文，然後把廣告文法抄進作文。廣告英文故意斷句、故意不合文法，因為它只有三秒鐘。要明講，不然老師得花好幾個月改「Think different」這類句子。
items: Think different. ← 文法上該是 differently（Apple 故意的）
Got milk? ← 完整應是 Have you got milk?
Because you're worth it. ← 這句沒有主要子句
規則：廣告可以這樣寫，你的作文不行。
Your turn: 把上面三句改寫成完整、合文法的句子。

practice.title_zh: 荒謬商品推銷・商品表
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs products, so here are eight. Draw one, get four minutes, then perform the thirty seconds. The sillier the product, the harder the language has to work — that is the point.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要商品，這裡備了八樣。抽一樣、四分鐘準備、上台講三十秒。商品越荒謬，語言就得越用力——這正是重點。
items: an invisible backpack · teleporting shoes · homework that does itself
a pillow that wakes you up gently in English · an umbrella that never blows inside out
a water bottle that refills itself · glasses that translate what your teacher says
a bicycle that remembers where you parked it
Must include: 2 imperatives · 3 persuasive adjectives · the word 'you' at least four times
Must end with: a promise and a reason to act now.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句標語
practice.note_en: Eight words or fewer, one imperative, one strong adjective. Short is harder than long — that is why this is the exit ticket.
practice.note_zh: 八個字以內，含一個祈使句、一個強形容詞。短比長難——所以這才是出場券。
items: Product: ______
Slogan: ______

37.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom's sound-on then sound-off comparison is the whole lesson, so protect the time for it. What students discover is what English carries that pictures cannot: who has the power, whether someone is joking, and how close the two people are.
37.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 設計的「先有聲再靜音」對照就是整堂課，時間要留給它。學生會發現英文承載了畫面給不了的東西：誰有主導權、對方是不是在開玩笑、兩個人有多熟。

words.example: The main character never says what she wants.
words.more: 第 22、23 週學過

words.example: This scene lasts ninety seconds.
words.more: scene 一場戲 · setting 是背景（第 22 週）

words.example: Watch his expression when she leaves.
words.more: 第 34 週的另一個意思：語言的說法

words.example: Her reaction tells you everything.
words.more: react (v.) → reaction (n.)

words.example: What is the relationship between these two?
words.more: 不只指戀愛 · 家人、同事、師生都算

words.example: You can feel the tension in the room.
words.more: tense (adj.) → tension (n.)

words.example: That line was hilarious.
words.more: 極端字 · 不加 very（第 13 週）

words.example: The music makes it feel more dramatic.
words.more: 第 15 週學過

practice.title_en: Sound on, sound off · what English adds
practice.title_zh: 有聲、靜音・英文多給了什麼
practice.note_en: Dom's activity, with the comparison written out. Play with sound, then muted, then ask this list. The gap between the two viewings is where the English lives.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動，把對照題目寫出來。先有聲播一次、再靜音播一次，然後問這幾題。兩次之間的差距，就是英文存在的地方。
items: 靜音看得出來的：誰在生氣 · 誰先離開 · 發生了什麼事
只有聲音告訴你的：他是不是在開玩笑 · 誰在這段關係裡比較有主導權 · 他們有多熟
Q1 They are ______ (friends / family / strangers). How do you know from the words?
Q2 Which line changes the mood? Read it aloud in two different tones.
Q3 Is anyone lying? What did you hear that the picture did not show?

practice.title_en: The trap · sarcasm is invisible until it is named
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・反話不點破就看不見
practice.note_en: English drops into sarcasm constantly and marks it only with tone. Learners take it literally and miss the joke, or worse, think the speaker meant it. Play one line two ways and the whole class hears it at once.
practice.note_zh: 英文經常說反話，而且只用語氣標記。學習者照字面理解，不是錯過笑點，就是以為對方是認真的。同一句用兩種語氣各唸一次，全班立刻就聽出來了。
items: "Great. Just great." ← 語氣一變，意思完全相反
"Oh, that's brilliant." ← 可能是稱讚，也可能是「你完蛋了」
"Thanks a lot." ← 字面是道謝，語氣可以是責怪
線索：拉長的音 · 平板的語調 · 跟畫面明顯不符的字
Your turn: 找出這場戲裡一句表面與真意相反的話。

practice.title_zh: 場景偵探・八個觀察
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks for eight observations and five expressions. Split them so students know what counts: an observation needs evidence, an expression needs to be reusable outside this film.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要八個觀察與五個說法。分清楚什麼算數：觀察必須帶證據，說法必須是離開這部片還用得上的。
items: 觀察（要帶證據）：I noticed ______ , which suggests ______ .
① 誰先說話？為什麼是他？
② 誰的句子比較短？（短句常代表生氣或有權力）
③ 有沒有人打斷別人？
④ 最後一句話是誰說的？
有用的說法（要能帶走）：不是劇情台詞，是像 "Hang on a second" 這種明天就能用的話。

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one line, two meanings
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句話，兩種意思
practice.note_en: Write one line from the scene and both readings of it. If they cannot find one, they have not been listening to tone.
practice.note_zh: 寫下戲裡的一句話，以及它的兩種解讀。找不到的話，代表還沒開始聽語氣。
items: The line: " ______ "
It could mean ______ , or it could mean ______ .

38.prep_en: No preparation needed, but be ready for the question students always ask: can I say this to my teacher? Dom's note asks you to teach when slang is appropriate, so build the whole lesson around the answer rather than the phrases. A student who knows ten expressions and no register rules will use them at exactly the wrong moment.
38.prep_zh: 不必備課，但要準備好回答學生一定會問的問題：這句可以對老師說嗎？Dom 在教案裡要求教「什麼時候適合」，所以整堂課圍著這個答案走，而不是圍著片語走。只學會十個說法、卻不懂場合的學生，一定會在最不該的時候用出來。

words.more: 朋友之間 · 不是真的在問問題 · ✗ 對校長說

words.example: "He finished it in ten minutes." "No way!"
words.more: 兩個意思：驚訝、或強烈拒絕

words.example: Relax, I'm kidding.
words.more: 第 37 週的反話救援包 · 也說 just joking

words.example: We hung out at the park after school.
words.more: hang → hung → hung · 沒有特定目的地相處

words.example: I finally figured out the answer.
words.more: = work out · 比 understand 口語

words.example: Chill out — we still have an hour.
words.more: 對朋友可以 · 對長輩不行

words.example: It's late — let's hit the road.
words.more: 慣用語 · 字面沒有意義，不要翻譯

practice.title_en: The trap · idioms do not translate, in either direction
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・慣用語兩個方向都不能直譯
practice.note_en: Students try to decode 'hit the road' word by word and get nowhere — and then they translate 馬馬虎虎 into English and get the same nowhere. Say it both ways: idioms are single units of meaning, in Chinese and in English alike.
practice.note_zh: 學生把 hit the road 拆成字去解，怎麼解都不對——然後他們把「馬馬虎虎」翻成英文，對方也一樣聽不懂。兩個方向都要講：慣用語在中文和英文裡都是一整塊意思，不能拆。
items: hit the road ≠ 打路　→　意思是「出發」
under the weather ≠ 在天氣下面　→　意思是「不舒服」
馬馬虎虎 ≠ horse horse tiger tiger　→　so-so / not bad
人山人海 ≠ people mountain people sea　→　packed / extremely crowded
規則：遇到拆不開的句子，就整句記起來。

practice.title_en: Formal or Friendly? · the two-column page
practice.title_zh: 正式還是親切？・兩欄對照表
practice.note_en: This is Dom's homework, started in class. The right-hand column is what matters — students already have the casual half from YouTube. Fill five here and the homework is half done.
practice.note_zh: 這就是 Dom 的作業，在課堂上先起頭。右欄才是關鍵——左邊那半學生早就從 YouTube 學會了。這裡填五組，作業就完成一半。
items: What's up? → How are you? / Good morning.
No way! → That's surprising. / I find that hard to believe.
hang out → spend time together
chill out → ______
figure out → ______
hit the road → ______
I'm kidding → ______

practice.title_zh: 你在跟誰說話？
practice.note_en: The answer to the question every student asks. Four listeners, and the same message has to change shape for each. This is the register lesson from Week 20 returning in a different costume.
practice.note_zh: 這是回答學生每次都會問的那個問題。四種聽話的人，同一句話要換四種形狀。這是第 20 週的語域課換了一身衣服回來。
items: 同一件事：你遲到了，要解釋。
① 對好朋友：Sorry, I totally lost track of time.
④ 寫 email 給實習單位：______
Rule: 越不熟、越正式，句子就越長。（第 20 週的禮貌階梯）

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one expression, one warning
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個說法，一個警告
practice.note_en: One casual expression they will actually use, plus the situation where it would be a mistake.
practice.note_zh: 寫一個他們真的會用的口語說法，再寫一個「用了會出事」的場合。
items: Expression: ______
I would not say this to ______ , because ______ .

39.prep_en: No preparation needed. Taiwan teaches American English, so students assume everything else is wrong — including their own. Dom's note asks you to celebrate English as an international language and to include Taiwan in it. That framing is the lesson: being understood matters more than sounding American.
39.prep_zh: 不必備課。台灣教美式英語，所以學生會以為其他都是錯的——包括自己的。Dom 在教案裡要求把英語當成國際語言來慶祝，而且要把台灣放進去。這個定位就是這堂課：被聽懂，比聽起來像美國人重要。

words.example: Taiwan mostly teaches American English.
words.more: 拼字：color · center · traveled

words.example: British English uses 'lift' for elevator.
words.more: 拼字：colour · centre · travelled

words.example: Australian English has its own vocabulary too.
words.more: arvo = afternoon · 母音差異明顯

words.example: Everyone has an accent, including native speakers.
words.more: 重要觀念：沒有人「沒有口音」

words.example: Her pronunciation is clear and easy to follow.
words.more: 注意拼字：不是 pronounciation · pronounce (v.)

words.example: Take the elevator. / Take the lift.
words.more: 美 / 英 · 兩個都對

words.example: We live in a small apartment. / …a small flat.
words.more: 美 / 英

words.example: summer vacation / summer holidays
words.more: 美 / 英 · 英式的 holiday 也指國定假日

practice.title_en: The trap · there is no one correct English
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・沒有唯一正確的英語
practice.note_en: Students think American English is the real one and everything else is a deviation — so they freeze when they meet an Indian or Singaporean speaker, and they are ashamed of their own accent. More people speak English as a second language than as a first. Say that number out loud.
practice.note_zh: 學生以為美式英語才是真的，其他都是偏離——所以遇到印度或新加坡口音就當機，也為自己的口音感到羞恥。全世界把英語當第二語言的人，比母語者還多。把這個事實講出來。
items: 說英語的人裡，非母語者多於母語者。
沒有人「沒有口音」——美國人也有口音，只是你聽習慣了。
目標不是聽起來像美國人，是「被聽懂」。
台灣人講的英語也是一種英語，它讓台灣被世界聽見。
Ask the class: 你聽過幾種英語口音？在哪裡聽到的？

practice.title_en: Accent Detective · same meaning, different word
practice.title_zh: 口音偵探・同義不同字
practice.note_en: Dom's activity, with the map started. Her homework asks for ten pairs, so fill these and let teams hunt for the rest. The point is not to memorize which is which — it is to stop panicking when the unfamiliar one appears.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動，地圖先起個頭。她的作業要十組，這裡填完，其餘讓各組自己找。重點不是背哪個是哪國，而是遇到不熟的那個時不要慌。
items: elevator / lift　·　apartment / flat　·　vacation / holiday
fries / chips　·　cookie / biscuit　·　soccer / football
trash / rubbish　·　subway / underground　·　line / queue
fall / autumn　·　truck / lorry　·　pants / trousers　← 這組誤會最大
Bonus: 台灣的英語裡有哪些字是我們自己的？（例如 scooter、night market）

practice.title_zh: 跨口音聽力
practice.note_en: Play three short clips from three places without saying where they are from. Students write what they understood, then guess the country. The surprise is usually that they understood more than they expected.
practice.note_zh: 播三段來自不同地方的短片，先不說是哪裡。學生寫下聽懂的內容，再猜國家。通常的驚喜是：他們聽懂的比自己以為的多。
items: Which was easiest? Why — the speed, the words, or just familiarity?
Rule: 「聽不懂」要說成「我還不習慣這個口音」——那是實話，也比較準確。

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · your English, your place
practice.title_zh: 出場券・你的英語，你的位置
practice.note_en: Dom asks for Taiwan's place in the English-speaking world, so end on it. One sentence, and it should be about being understood, not about sounding like someone else.
practice.note_zh: Dom 要求談台灣在英語世界的位置，就收在這裡。一句話，重點放在「被聽懂」，不是「像誰」。
items: I use English to ______ .
One day I want to explain ______ to someone from another country.

40.prep_en: No preparation needed — the Movie English Guide that Dom's homework refers to is written out below, first half ready to photocopy. Her note asks you to frame the movie as a celebration, not a test, so give out the guide before the film and let students choose what they will watch for.
40.prep_zh: 不必備課——Dom 作業裡提到的 Movie English Guide 已經寫在下面，前半部可以直接影印。她要求把看電影定位成慶祝而不是考試，所以看片前就把表發下去，讓學生自己選要盯著什麼看。

words.example: The theme of the film is forgiveness.
words.more: theme 是「關於什麼道理」· plot 是「發生什麼事」

words.example: The plot moves very quickly at the start.
words.more: 發生的事件 · 不是主題

words.example: The side characters are the best part.
words.more: main character 主角 · side character 配角

words.example: The central conflict is between duty and family.
words.more: 第 22 週學過 · 故事的引擎

words.example: What message does the director want us to take home?
words.more: 第 34 週學過

words.example: I would recommend it to anyone who likes quiet films.
words.more: 第 20 週學過 · recommend it TO someone

words.example: Critics criticized the ending, but I liked it.
words.more: criticize (v.) · criticism (n.) · critic (人)

words.example: The most memorable scene is the one with no words.
words.more: memory → memorable

practice.title_zh: 電影英語學習單・前半
practice.note_en: This is the guide Dom's homework asks for. Hand it out before the film. The last line matters most: choosing one thing to watch for turns passive viewing into listening practice.
practice.note_zh: 這就是 Dom 作業要的學習單，看片前發下去。最後一行最重要：選定一件要盯著看的事，會把被動觀看變成聽力練習。
items: Title: ______ 　Year: ______ 　Where it is set: ______
Main character: ______ 　What they want: ______
The problem in one sentence: ______
Ten words I heard and want to keep: ______
My job while watching (choose one): 追一個角色 · 抄下十句台詞 · 只聽語氣不看字幕 · 記下每個我聽不懂的地方
(Second half — theme, opinion, review — comes after the film.)

practice.title_en: Prediction cards · before you press play
practice.title_zh: 預測卡・按下播放之前
practice.note_en: Dom's launch activity. Watch the trailer, pause, and write the cards. Sealed until after the film, then opened — students are far more invested in a story they made a bet on.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的啟動活動。看完預告、暫停、寫卡片。封起來，看完電影再拆開——押過注的故事，學生投入程度完全不同。
items: I predict the main character will ______ .
I predict the ending will be ______ (happy / sad / surprising).
One thing I think will go wrong: ______
One word I expect to hear many times: ______
Sign your card and seal it.

practice.title_en: plot or theme? · the difference that trips everyone
practice.title_zh: 劇情還是主題？・大家都會絆倒的分別
practice.note_en: Students write plot summaries when asked for themes, every time. Plot is what happened; theme is what it was about. One is a list of events, the other is an idea — and only the second one can be argued about.
practice.note_zh: 每次問主題，學生都會寫劇情。劇情是「發生了什麼」，主題是「關於什麼」。一個是事件清單，一個是一個想法——而且只有後者可以拿來辯論。
items: Plot: A boy loses his dog and searches the whole city for three days.
Theme: What we are willing to do for the ones we love.
Test: 主題應該可以套用在另一部完全不同的電影上。劇情不行。
Your turn: 想一部你看過的電影，寫一句劇情、一句主題。

practice.title_zh: 出場券・你的那一件任務
practice.note_en: Each student commits to one thing they will watch for, in writing, before they leave. Public commitment is what makes it actually happen.
practice.note_zh: 每個學生離開前，用寫的承諾一件他要盯著看的事。寫出來的承諾才會真的執行。
items: While I watch, my job is to ______ .
I will bring back ______ to the next class.
